  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

<script>
      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

            <h3>5. Set a reorder point</h3>
            <p>

            <h3>6. Plan for multiple locations</h3>

        </h2>


        <div class="wpx-faq">

          <details>
            <summary>
              What cleaning supplies does a commercial facility need for fall?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              A commercial facility should plan supplies around its actual cleaning program and point-of-use needs. Depending on the environment, that can include cleaning wipes, disinfecting products where required and appropriate, dispensers or wipe stations, backup inventory, and other janitorial supplies. The procurement step is matching quantity and format to real facility usage.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              How should a business prepare for cold and flu season cleaning?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              Start before seasonal demand increases by identifying high-touch surfaces, reviewing cleaning frequency, checking supply levels, and making sure appropriate cleaning or disinfecting products are available where they are needed. Follow the directions and required contact time on any disinfecting product label and align the program with your facility's procedures.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              How do I calculate how many wipes my facility needs?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              Start with the number of facility locations, cleaning points per location, average wipes used per point each day, and operating days per month. Multiply those values to estimate monthly demand: Locations × Cleaning Points per Location × Average Wipes per Point per Day × Operating Days. Then compare the estimate with recent consumption and set your inventory buffer and reorder point based on your facility's replenishment policy.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              Are alcohol wipes the same as disinfecting wipes?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              No. Alcohol wipes are not automatically EPA-registered disinfectants. Wipe selection should depend on the task, surface, product formulation, and the claims or procedures your facility requires. When disinfection is required, use an appropriate EPA-registered disinfecting product and follow its label directions.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              What wipes are used for gym equipment?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              The right wipe depends on the equipment surface, cleaning task, frequency of use, and facility volume. For routine equipment cleaning, choose a wipe designed for the intended application and appropriate for the surfaces being cleaned. For high-volume facilities, bulk refill formats and convenient dispensing can also simplify daily operations.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              Can businesses buy cleaning wipes in bulk?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              Yes. Bulk purchasing can be useful when wipe consumption is recurring and predictable. Facilities can compare pack size, wipe format, number of cleaning points, number of locations, storage capacity, and reorder frequency to build a practical purchasing plan.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              What does EWG Verified® mean for cleaning wipes?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              EWG Verified® is a mark from the Environmental Working Group for products that meet EWG standards related to ingredient safety and transparency. The EWG Verified® mark is not a disinfection or EPA-registration claim. Wipex currently features EWG Verified® Gym Wipes, Empower® Yoga Mat Wipes, and Table Bussers® products on its dedicated EWG page.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              Which Wipex collection is right for my facility?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              Start with the primary environment and cleaning task. Facilities sourcing isopropyl alcohol wipes can explore the Alcohol Wipes collection. Gyms, studios, and fitness facilities can explore Gym Wipes. Restaurants, cafés, catering operations, and other food-service environments can explore Food Service Wipes.
            </div>
          </details>


          <details>
            <summary>
              How can procurement teams simplify wipe purchasing across multiple locations?
            </summary>
            <div class="wpx-faq__answer">
              A practical approach is to standardize core wipe SKUs and formats where the same application exists across locations, define minimum inventory levels, establish reorder points, and review actual consumption regularly. This can make ordering and replenishment more predictable while reducing unnecessary SKU variation.
            </div>
          </details>

      if(!article){

      var rect =
        article.getBoundingClientRect();


      var total =
        article.offsetHeight -

        var scrolled =
          Math.min(

            ),
            total > 0
              ? total
              : 1
          );


        var percent =
          total > 0
            ? (scrolled / total) * 100
            : 0;


        progress.style.width =
          percent + "%";

      }


      if(
        sticky &&
        !stickyDismissed
      ){

        var pastHero =
          rect.top < -320;


        var finalCta =
          root.querySelector(

          );


        var nearFinal =
          finalCta
            ? finalCta
              .getBoundingClientRect()
              .top < window.innerHeight
            : false;

          pastHero &&
          !nearFinal;


        sticky.classList.toggle(

        );

          "aria-hidden",
          shouldShow
            ? "false"
            : "true"
        );

    root
      .querySelectorAll(
        ".wpx-toc__list a"
      )
      .forEach(
        function(link){

          function onAnchorClick(event){

  var href =
    link.getAttribute(
      "href"
    );


  if(
    !href ||
    href.charAt(0) !== "#"
  ){
    return;
  }


  var target =
    root.querySelector(
      href
    );


  if(!target){
    return;
  }


  event.preventDefault();


  /*
    Calculate the actual top offset used by the page.
    This protects the TOC anchors from landing underneath
    Shopify's sticky header/navigation.
  */

  var isMobile =
    window.innerWidth <= 680;


  var offset =
    isMobile
      ? 88
      : 112;


  /*

  */

  var headerCandidates =
    document.querySelectorAll(
      "header, sticky-header, " +
      "[data-sticky-header], " +
      ".header-wrapper, " +
      ".shopify-section-header-sticky"
    );


  headerCandidates.forEach(
    function(header){

      if(
        !header ||
        header === root
      ){
        return;
      }


      var styles =
        window.getComputedStyle(
          header
        );


      var position =
        styles.position;


      if(
        position !== "fixed" &&
        position !== "sticky"
      ){
        return;
      }


      var rect =
        header.getBoundingClientRect();


      if(
        rect.top <= 2 &&
        rect.bottom > 0 &&
        rect.height > 0
      ){

        offset =
          Math.max(
            offset,
            Math.ceil(
              rect.bottom + 12
            )
          );

      }

    }
  );


  /*

  var progress =
    root.querySelector(
      ".wpx-progress"
    );


  if(progress){

    offset +=
      progress.getBoundingClientRect().height;

  }


  var targetTop =
    window.pageYOffset +

  targetTop =

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

<script>
      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

</script></div>

        <h2>What Is World Cleanup Day 2026 — and Why Should a Gym Care?</h2>
        <p><strong>World Cleanup Day is a global civic event, held on September 20, 2026.</strong> For fitness facilities, its real value isn't activism — it's timing. It falls right as fall sign-ups and packed class calendars increase member traffic, which is exactly when your everyday cleaning routine is put under the most pressure.</p>
        <p>Use the date as a trigger to audit what already exists in your facility: whether wipes are within reach at every high-touch zone, whether stations run out of refills, whether restocking depends on someone remembering, and whether every location runs the same setup. A gym cleaning routine only works if it works when you're not watching — this guide is about building one that does.</p>
        <div class="wpx-callout">
          <p><strong>The one-line version:</strong> World Cleanup Day 2026 (September 20) is a practical checkpoint for reviewing your gym's wipe access, refill inventory, dispensing, and replenishment before peak-season traffic arrives.</p>

<!-- ================= BUSINESS & COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS ================= -->
    <section class="wpx-section" style="background:var(--wcd-powder-bg);">
      <div class="wpx-wrap wpx-read">
        <h2>Gym Cleaning for Business & Commercial Facilities</h2>
        <p>If you operate multiple fitness locations, manage a commercial facility with shared workout spaces, or oversee a corporate wellness program, the same system applies — scaled to your volume and standardized across every site.</p>

        <h3 style="margin-top:28px;">Standardizing Across Locations</h3>
        <p>Each location cleaning independently means scattered inventory, different formats at each site, and restocking problems that repeat. Standardization — one wipe format, one bulk refill, one or two dispenser styles — turns a complicated multi-site supply chain into a repeatable, forecastable routine.</p>
        
        <div class="wpx-bg-grid" style="margin:18px 0 28px;">
          <div class="wpx-bg-card">
            <h3 style="font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:8px;">Centralized Purchasing</h3>
            <p>Consistent SKUs reduce negotiation complexity and lock in cost per unit across all locations.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="wpx-bg-card">
            <h3 style="font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:8px;">Unified Staff Training</h3>
            <p>Staff trained at one location already know the system at every other location.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="wpx-bg-card">
            <h3 style="font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:8px;">Predictable Replenishment</h3>
            <p>Reorder frequency and reorder points are forecastable across your portfolio.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="wpx-bg-card">
            <h3 style="font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:8px;">Consistent Member Experience</h3>
            <p>Access and supply are identical regardless of which facility members visit.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h3>Procurement & Bulk Ordering</h3>
        <p>Multi-location operators typically move to recurring replenishment orders — setting a monthly or quarterly refill schedule so supply arrives before any station runs dry. This removes the reorder-from-memory problem entirely. For high-volume use, the 700ct bulk refill roll becomes the standard unit, and you order in multiples per location per month based on historical usage.</p>
        <p>Bulk ordering also locks in unit cost and removes week-to-week price variation. A facility using 2–4 bulk rolls per month per location can forecast annual supply cost within a narrow band.</p>

        <h3>Multi-Location Compliance & Audit</h3>
        <p>When every location runs the same wipe, refill, and dispenser format, auditing is simple: walk each site, count dispensers at each zone, check refill stock on hand, and confirm the system is in place. No format confusion, no training gaps, no "this location does it differently" surprises. For compliance documentation, a standardized setup is also easier to photograph and verify.</p>

        <div class="wpx-callout" style="margin-top:22px;">
          <p><strong>Multi-location checklist:</strong> Standardize wipe + refill + dispenser formats. Set a recurring replenishment schedule. Assign ownership by location. Build a quarterly audit routine.</p>
        </div>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

        <div class="wpx-faq"><details >
              <summary>What are 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes used for in commercial settings?</summary>
              <div class="wpx-faq__a">Commercial and industrial teams use 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes to remove dust, oils, fingerprints, and general residue from non-porous surfaces such as electronics, facilities equipment, workbenches, and office touchpoints. They are formulated for fast evaporation and a residue-free finish rather than for disinfecting.</div>
            </details><details >
              <summary>How Are Wipex Alcohol Wipes Different from Disinfecting Wipes?</summary>
              <div class="wpx-faq__a">No. Wipex isopropyl alcohol wipes are cleaning wipes and are not registered or labeled as disinfectants. The Wipex EPA-Registered Disinfecting Wipes Roll is the only Wipex product labeled for disinfecting and surface sanitizing use.</div>
            </details><details >
              <summary>What is the difference between the 1000-count bucket, 80-count canister, and 100-count sachet box?</summary>
              <div class="wpx-faq__a">The formats differ by use case: the 1000-count bucket suits high-volume facilities restocking shared dispensers, the 80-count canister suits single workstations or desks, and the 100-count sachet box provides individually wrapped wipes for labs or field settings needing one-wipe per-task control.</div>
            </details><details >
              <summary>Can these alcohol wipes be used on any surface?</summary>
              <div class="wpx-faq__a">Wipex does not make a universal or all-surfaces compatibility claim for isopropyl alcohol wipes. Always check the product label and your equipment manufacturer cleaning guidance, and test on a small, inconspicuous area before regular use on a new material.</div>
            </details><details >
              <summary>How do procurement teams calculate bulk order sizes for alcohol wipes?</summary>
              <div class="wpx-faq__a">Estimate wipes-per-day at each cleaning station, multiply by the number of stations and the restocking interval, then add a buffer for high-traffic periods. Standardizing on one format across a facility also simplifies dispenser maintenance and reorder tracking.</div>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

<script>
      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

  font-size: 12px;
}

.wipex-breadcrumb__item--active {
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO SECTION
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-hero {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--wipex-dark) 0%, #1a5a44 55%, var(--wipex-green) 100%);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 80px 0 90px;
}

.wipex-hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 80% 20%, rgba(47,158,120,0.25) 0%, transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 80% at -10% 80%, rgba(18,63,48,0.4) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.wipex-hero__pattern {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Ccircle cx='30' cy='30' r='2'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  pointer-events: none;
}

.wipex-hero__inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: center;
}

.wipex-hero__meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.wipex-hero__heading {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 54px);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: white;
  line-height: 1.12;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.wipex-hero__heading em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: #7DDCB5;
}

.wipex-hero__subtext {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82);
  line-height: 1.65;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
  max-width: 520px;
}

.wipex-hero__cta-group {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}

.wipex-hero__trust {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 36px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.wipex-hero__trust-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.wipex-hero__trust-icon {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  background: rgba(125,220,181,0.25);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.wipex-hero__trust-icon svg {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  fill: #7DDCB5;
}

/* Hero Image Side */
.wipex-hero__visual {
  position: relative;
}

.wipex-hero__img-wrap {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
}

.wipex-hero__img-wrap img,
.wipex-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.wipex-img-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 100%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.wipex-img-placeholder__icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  opacity: 0.35;
}

.wipex-img-placeholder__caption {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 200px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.wipex-hero__stat-cards {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -18px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  width: calc(100% - 32px);
  justify-content: center;
}

.wipex-stat-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
  text-align: center;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.wipex-stat-card__number {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--wipex-dark);
  line-height: 1;
}

.wipex-stat-card__label {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-top: 3px;
}

/* ============================================================
   PROBLEM STRIP
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-problem-strip {
  background: var(--wipex-dark);
  padding: 40px 0;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--wipex-accent);
}

.wipex-problem-strip__inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 40px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.wipex-problem-strip__problems {
  display: flex;
  gap: 32px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  flex: 1;
}

.wipex-problem-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 180px;
}

.wipex-problem-item__icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  background: rgba(231,80,60,0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(231,80,60,0.3);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.wipex-problem-item__icon svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  fill: #FF7043;
}

.wipex-problem-item__text {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.wipex-problem-item__text strong {
  color: white;
  display: block;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.wipex-problem-strip__cta {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ============================================================
   TABLE OF CONTENTS
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-toc {
  background: var(--wipex-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius-lg);
  padding: 32px 36px;
  margin: 56px 0 0;
}

.wipex-toc__heading {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--wipex-green);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.wipex-toc__heading::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  width: 4px;
  height: 18px;
  background: var(--wipex-green);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.wipex-toc__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px 32px;
  list-style: none;
}

.wipex-toc__grid li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
}

.wipex-toc__grid li:last-child,
.wipex-toc__grid li:nth-last-child(-n+2) {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.wipex-toc__num {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--wipex-accent);
  min-width: 22px;
}

.wipex-toc__grid a {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.4;
  transition: color 0.18s;
}

.wipex-toc__grid a:hover {
  color: var(--wipex-green);
}

/* ============================================================
   ARTICLE BODY LAYOUT
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-article-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 60px;
  padding: 64px 0 80px;
  align-items: start;
}

.wipex-article-main > * + * {
  margin-top: 72px;
}

/* ============================================================
   SECTION HEADERS
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-section-header {
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.wipex-section-header__title {
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.wipex-section-header__title em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--wipex-green);
}

.wipex-section-header__lead {
  font-size: 17px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 680px;
}

.wipex-divider {
  width: 48px;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--wipex-accent);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

/* ============================================================
   INTRO SECTION / WHY FLU SEASON CHANGES DEMAND
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-intro-section {
  padding-top: 0;
}

.wipex-intro-body {
  font-size: 17px;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.wipex-intro-body p + p {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.wipex-callout-box {
  background: var(--wipex-soft);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--wipex-accent);
  border-radius: 0 var(--wipex-radius) var(--wipex-radius) 0;
  padding: 22px 26px;
  margin: 28px 0;
}

.wipex-callout-box--green {
  background: var(--wipex-light);
  border-left-color: var(--wipex-green);
}

.wipex-callout-box__title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--wipex-green);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.wipex-callout-box__body {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

/* Demand Shift Cards */
.wipex-demand-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 32px;
}

.wipex-demand-card {
  background: var(--wipex-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius);
  padding: 22px;
  transition: var(--wipex-transition);
}

.wipex-demand-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--wipex-accent);
  box-shadow: var(--wipex-shadow);
}

.wipex-demand-card__icon {
  font-size: 28px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.wipex-demand-card__title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.wipex-demand-card__body {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

/* ============================================================
   IMAGE MODULES
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-img-module {
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.wipex-img-module--hero {
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--wipex-light) 0%, var(--wipex-soft) 100%);
}

.wipex-img-module--editorial {
  aspect-ratio: 2/3;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--wipex-light) 0%, var(--wipex-soft) 100%);
}

.wipex-img-module--wide {
  aspect-ratio: 21/9;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--wipex-soft) 0%, var(--wipex-light) 100%);
}

.wipex-img-module__inner {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 24px;
}

.wipex-img-module__placeholder-icon {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  background: rgba(31,111,84,0.12);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.wipex-img-module__placeholder-icon svg {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  fill: var(--wipex-green);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.wipex-img-placeholder__caption {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.4;
  max-width: 220px;
}

/* ============================================================
   HIGH-TOUCH SURFACE FRAMEWORK
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-definition-block {
  background: var(--wipex-light);
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius);
  padding: 24px 28px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.wipex-definition-block__term {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--wipex-green);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.wipex-definition-block__def {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  line-height: 1.65;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.wipex-surface-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 28px;
}

.wipex-surface-card {
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius);
  padding: 22px;
  transition: var(--wipex-transition);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.wipex-surface-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--wipex-green);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform 0.22s ease;
  transform-origin: left;
}

.wipex-surface-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--wipex-accent);
  box-shadow: var(--wipex-shadow);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.wipex-surface-card:hover::before {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

.wipex-surface-card__venue {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--wipex-accent);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.wipex-surface-card__title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.wipex-surface-card__list {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.wipex-surface-card__list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
}

.wipex-surface-card__list li::before {
  content: '';
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--wipex-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.wipex-surface-card__freq {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.wipex-surface-card__freq-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.wipex-surface-card__freq-value {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--wipex-dark);
  background: var(--wipex-light);
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}

/* Protocol Steps */
.wipex-protocol-steps {
  margin-top: 36px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.wipex-protocol-step {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius);
  padding: 22px 24px;
  transition: var(--wipex-transition);
}

.wipex-protocol-step:hover {
  border-color: var(--wipex-accent);
  box-shadow: var(--wipex-shadow);
}

.wipex-protocol-step__num {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  background: var(--wipex-green);
  color: white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.wipex-protocol-step__content {
  flex: 1;
}

.wipex-protocol-step__title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.wipex-protocol-step__body {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ============================================================
   PROCUREMENT GUIDE
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-procurement-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 28px;
}

.wipex-procurement-card {
  background: var(--wipex-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius);
  padding: 24px;
}

.wipex-procurement-card__num {
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--wipex-line);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.wipex-procurement-card__title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.wipex-procurement-card__body {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ============================================================
   CDC GUIDANCE SECTION
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-cdc-section {
  background: var(--wipex-soft);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius-lg);
  padding: 40px;
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
}

.wipex-cdc-callout {
  background: white;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--wipex-green);
  border-radius: 0 var(--wipex-radius) var(--wipex-radius) 0;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}

.wipex-cdc-callout__source {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--wipex-green);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.wipex-cdc-callout__quote {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  line-height: 1.65;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ============================================================
   MID-PAGE CTA BAND
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-cta-band {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--wipex-dark) 0%, var(--wipex-green) 100%);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius-lg);
  padding: 48px 48px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 32px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.wipex-cta-band::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -40%;
  right: -10%;
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.wipex-cta-band__content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.wipex-cta-band__eyebrow {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.wipex-cta-band__title {
  font-size: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 30px);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: white;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.wipex-cta-band__sub {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.wipex-cta-band__actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.wipex-cta-band__note {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  text-align: right;
}

/* ============================================================
   BUYING GUIDE
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-criteria-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 28px;
}

.wipex-criteria-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius);
  transition: var(--wipex-transition);
}

.wipex-criteria-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--wipex-accent);
  background: var(--wipex-soft);
}

.wipex-criteria-item__icon {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  background: var(--wipex-light);
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 20px;
}

.wipex-criteria-item__title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--wipex-ink);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.wipex-criteria-item__body {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--wipex-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ============================================================
   COMPARISON TABLE
   ============================================================ */
.wipex-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border-radius: var(--wipex-radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--wipex-line);

        <!-- ====================================================
             SECTION 1: WHY FLU SEASON CHANGES DEMAND
             ==================================================== -->
        <section id="why-flu-season-changes-demand" class="wipex-intro-section" aria-labelledby="s1-heading">
          <div class="wipex-section-header">
            <span class="wipex-section-label">Section 01</span>
            <div class="wipex-divider" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <h2 class="wipex-section-header__title" id="s1-heading">
              Why Flu Season Changes <em>Facility Cleaning Demand</em>
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div class="wipex-intro-body">
            <p>Every fall, facility managers across the United States face the same operational challenge: respiratory illness season arrives, cleaning protocols come under sharper scrutiny, and the demand for commercial disinfecting wipes surges — often faster than unprepared supply chains can respond. For facilities that wait until October to think about flu season preparedness, restocking is already a reactive scramble rather than a strategic program.</p>

            <p>The distinction matters enormously at the operational level. Facilities that establish structured high-touch surface cleaning programs before flu season peaks — using EPA-registered disinfecting wipes deployed through wall-mounted dispenser systems — are able to maintain consistent cleaning frequency across all locations and departments, without relying on ad-hoc purchasing decisions made under supply pressure.</p>

            <!-- Wide Environmental Image Placeholder -->
            
<figure class="wipex-img-module wipex-img-module--wide" style="margin:28px 0;">
  <img
    src="//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/A_highly_realistic_premium_commercial_photograph_i-1788982002649_1600x.png?v=1788983334"
    alt=""
    loading="lazy">
</figure>


            <p>Fall and flu season also brings a material increase in the number of high-traffic touchpoints requiring attention. Shared spaces — conference rooms, break rooms, elevator banks, reception desks, fitness facilities — see elevated use as staff return from summer flexibility to in-office routines, amplifying the transmission opportunity at precisely the touchpoints where a single wipe placed in a wall-mounted dispenser can make the most programmatic difference.</p>

            <div class="wipex-callout-box wipex-callout-box--green">
              <div class="wipex-callout-box__title">The Facility Manager's Strategic Shift</div>
              <div class="wipex-callout-box__body">The most operationally efficient facilities treat flu season not as an emergency response, but as a seasonal planning cycle — the same way they plan HVAC maintenance or security protocols. Disinfecting wipe system stocking, dispenser placement reviews, and staff training should be completed in September, not November.</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Demand Shift Cards -->
          <div class="wipex-demand-grid" role="list" aria-label="Key facility demand shifts during flu season">
            <div class="wipex-demand-card" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">📈</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__title">Wipe Consumption Increases</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__body">High-traffic facilities often experience increased wipe consumption during respiratory illness season. Under-stocked facilities risk running out of supplies during routine cleaning procedures.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="wipex-demand-card" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🏢</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__title">More Active Touchpoints</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__body">Post-summer return-to-office cycles increase shared surface contact across conference rooms, lobbies, break rooms, and restroom fixtures simultaneously.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="wipex-demand-card" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🛡️</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__title">Compliance Scrutiny Rises</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__body">Risk managers, HR departments, and building owners increasingly expect EPA-registered disinfecting wipes to be used in formal cleaning protocols during respiratory illness seasons.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="wipex-demand-card" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">🌐</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__title">Multi-Location Coordination Needed</div>
              <div class="wipex-demand-card__body">Operators managing multiple locations need a standardized wipe system that can be deployed identically across every site — from corporate offices to fitness facilities to hospitality venues.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- ====================================================
             SECTION 2: HIGH-TOUCH SURFACE FRAMEWORK
             ==================================================== -->

          <div class="wipex-section-header">
            <span class="wipex-section-label">Section 02</span>
            <div class="wipex-divider" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <h2 class="wipex-section-header__title" id="s2-heading">
              High-Touch Surface <em>Cleaning Framework</em>
            </h2>
            <p class="wipex-section-header__lead">A structured approach to identifying, prioritizing, and systematically cleaning the surfaces that matter most in your commercial facility during flu season.</p>

  <figure class="wipex-img-module wipex-img-module--wide" style="margin:28px 0;">

          <div class="wipex-definition-block" role="definition" aria-label="Definition: High-touch surfaces">
            <div class="wipex-definition-block__term">Definition: What Are High-Touch Surfaces?</div>
            <div class="wipex-definition-block__def">High-touch surfaces are surfaces that are frequently contacted by multiple people throughout the day, such as door handles, elevator buttons, light switches, shared keyboards, countertops, faucet handles, and restroom fixtures. Because these surfaces are touched repeatedly by different individuals, they require more frequent cleaning and disinfection — particularly during respiratory illness seasons when facility cleaning programs must be operating at full capacity.</div>

          <h3 style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--wipex-ink);margin:40px 0 8px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;">The 5-Step High-Touch Surface Disinfecting Protocol</h3>
          <p style="font-size:15px;color:var(--wipex-muted);line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:8px;">A structured, repeatable protocol that any cleaning staff member can execute consistently with Wipex EPA-Registered Disinfecting Wipes.</p>

          <div class="wipex-protocol-steps" role="list" aria-label="5-step high-touch surface disinfecting protocol">
            <div class="wipex-protocol-step" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__num" aria-hidden="true">1</div>
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__content">
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__title">Identify & Prioritize Your High-Touch Surface Map</div>
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__body">Walk your facility and document every surface that receives repeated manual contact throughout the day. Assign a contact frequency tier to each surface area.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="wipex-protocol-step" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__num" aria-hidden="true">2</div>
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__content">
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__title">Pre-Clean Visibly Soiled Surfaces Before Disinfecting</div>
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__body">The CDC recommends cleaning surfaces before disinfecting when there is visible soiling. Dirt or organic matter can reduce disinfectant effectiveness.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="wipex-protocol-step" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__num" aria-hidden="true">3</div>
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__content">
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__title">Apply Wipex Disinfecting Wipe & Maintain Wet Contact Time</div>
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__body">Remove one wipe from the bulk roll and wipe the surface in overlapping strokes. The surface must remain visibly wet for the full contact time (15–30 seconds).</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="wipex-protocol-step" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__num" aria-hidden="true">4</div>
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__content">
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__title">Allow Surface to Air Dry — No Rinsing Required</div>
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__body">After the contact time has been met, allow the surface to air dry naturally. No rinsing or secondary wiping is required.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="wipex-protocol-step" role="listitem">
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__num" aria-hidden="true">5</div>
              <div class="wipex-protocol-step__content">
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__title">Document, Log & Refill Dispensers on Schedule</div>
                <div class="wipex-protocol-step__body">Maintain a simple cleaning log for each high-touch zone and refill dispensers before depletion to prevent protocol failures.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

<script>
      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }
