      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

    </nav><section id="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-problem" class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-sec">
      <span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-kicker">The Problem</span>
      <h2>The Real Cost of an Outdated Cleaning Routine</h2>
      <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-split">
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-split__text">
          <p>Most fitness facilities still clean the way they did a decade ago: paper towels, spray bottles, and stations that run empty at the worst possible moment. It looks functional. In practice, it quietly drains labor hours, inflates waste, and undermines the member experience you work hard to build.</p>
          <p>Paper towels shred on textured equipment and pile up in the trash. Spray bottles get refilled inconsistently, run dry mid-shift, and leave overspray on floors and electronics. Staff lose time hunting for supplies during between-class turnaround. And members notice — an empty station or a streaked machine reads as a facility that isn't paying attention.</p>
          <p>The deeper issue is that these are treated as separate problems: waste over here, labor over there, member perception somewhere else. They're not separate. They're symptoms of a cleaning routine that was never designed as a system.</p>
          <a class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-inline-cta" href="https://wipex.co/products/plant-based-bulk-rolls" data-cro="green-standards-problem-cta">Replace Your Old Cleaning Routine →</a>
        </div>
        <figure class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-split__media"><img class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-img"
                 src="//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_-_2026-08-18T161152.831.png?v=1787080696&width=800"
                 srcset="//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_-_2026-08-18T161152.831.png?v=1787080696&width=500 500w, //wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_-_2026-08-18T161152.831.png?v=1787080696&width=800 800w, //wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_-_2026-08-18T161152.831.png?v=1787080696&width=1200 1200w"
                 sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 40vw"
                 width="913" height="1370"
                 alt="Staff wiping down a treadmill handle with a gym cleaning wipe between classes" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
      </div>

      <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-painrow">
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pain"><h3>Wasted Material</h3><p>Paper towels and disposable rolls generate constant trash and reordering.</p></div>
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pain"><h3>Wasted Labor</h3><p>Staff refill bottles, restock towels, and re-clean overspray instead of serving members.</p></div>
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pain"><h3>Inconsistent Stations</h3><p>Some stations are stocked, some are empty — the standard varies by hour.</p></div>
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pain"><h3>Member Perception</h3><p>Visible gaps in cleaning read as a facility that has stopped caring.</p></div>
      </div>
    </section><section id="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-standard" class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-sec wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-standard">
      <span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-kicker">Our Green Standards</span>
      <h2>Cleaning Should Be an Operating System — Not an Afterthought</h2>
      <p class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-lead">Sustainability isn't a one-day event or a marketing badge. In a modern fitness facility, it's an operating standard: plant-based materials that reduce waste, a system that's faster for staff to run, and stations that stay stocked and member-facing. When cleaning is designed as a system, sustainability and efficiency stop competing — they reinforce each other.</p>
      <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillars">
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar"><span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar__n">01</span><h3>Plant-Based Materials</h3><p>100% plant-based viscose cloth and a natural formula, instead of pallets of paper and plastic.</p></div>
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar"><span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar__n">02</span><h3>Operational Efficiency</h3><p>Grab-and-wipe format speeds up between-class turnaround and cuts restocking labor.</p></div>
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar"><span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar__n">03</span><h3>Member Experience</h3><p>Clean, consistent, well-stocked stations signal a premium, cared-for facility.</p></div>
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar"><span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-pillar__n">04</span><h3>Cost Control</h3><p>Bulk refill rolls lower cost per wipe and make replenishment predictable.</p></div>
      </div>
      <a class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-btn wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-btn--primary wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-btn--center" href="https://wipex.co/products/plant-based-bulk-rolls" data-cro="green-standards-standard-cta">Build Your Cleaning System →</a>
    </section><section id="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-why" class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-sec">
      <span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-kicker">The Shift</span>
      <h2>Why Modern Fitness Facilities Are Changing</h2>
      <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-split wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-split--rev">
        <figure class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-split__media"><img class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-img"
                 src="//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_79_18d00c22-adbd-4997-8897-4b23604b5f9d.png?v=1786047824&width=800"
                 srcset="//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_79_18d00c22-adbd-4997-8897-4b23604b5f9d.png?v=1786047824&width=500 500w, //wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_79_18d00c22-adbd-4997-8897-4b23604b5f9d.png?v=1786047824&width=800 800w, //wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Design_sem_nome_79_18d00c22-adbd-4997-8897-4b23604b5f9d.png?v=1786047824&width=1200 1200w"
                 sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 40vw"
                 width="2241" height="3362"
                 alt="Clean commercial gym floor with organized wipe dispenser stations" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
        <div class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-split__text">
          <p>Members now treat cleanliness as a baseline expectation, not a bonus. They compare your facility to boutique studios with visible, premium hygiene — and they vote with their memberships.</p>
          <p>At the same time, operators are under pressure to control costs and reduce waste without adding staff. A well-designed wipe system answers both: it's more sustainable, faster to run, and cheaper per clean at volume. That's why growing gyms, studio groups, and multi-location operators are moving away from ad-hoc supplies toward standardized cleaning systems.</p>
          <p>The facilities winning on retention aren't spending more on cleaning. They're spending smarter — turning hygiene into a visible, repeatable part of the brand experience.</p>
          <a class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-inline-cta" href="https://wipex.co/pages/studio-contact" data-cro="green-standards-why-cta">Talk to a Wipex Studio Specialist →</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section><section id="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-solution" class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-sec">
      <span class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-kicker">The Solution</span>
      <h2>The Wipex System: Wipes, Refills & Dispensers That Work Together</h2>

              <button type="button" class="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-faq__btn" data-wpxgs-faq-btn aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="wpxgs-template22131852345587greenstandardsaiH9HxYx-faq-3">

Wipes made with plant-based viscose cloth like Wipex clean sweat, body oils, and residue from gym equipment effectively while being gentler on surfaces than many harsh-chemical alternatives. They are built for daily, high-frequency use and help maintain a fresh, member-facing environment.               </button>

Wipex offers bulk formats built for commercial use, including extra-large 700ct refill rolls and 400ct dispensing buckets. Multi-location operators can standardize purchasing across all sites.</p></div>

              </button>

              </button>
            </h3>

              </button>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

<script>
      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }

      <div class="wpx-wrap"><span class="wpx-eyebrow">FAQ</span><h2 id="wpx-fh-template--23232579797235__blog_008_ai_cQzf3r">Fall gym cleaning and restocking questions, answered</h2>
        <div class="wpx-faq"><details class="wpx-qa" open >
              <summary><h3>What should be on a fall cleaning checklist for a gym?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>Six areas: deep-clean cardio and strength equipment, audit and repair every wipe dispenser, restock bulk wipes to a 60-day par level, verify EPA-registered disinfectant contact times and SDS records, reset locker rooms and high-touch surfaces, and refresh staff cleaning SOPs.</p></div>
            </details><details class="wpx-qa" >
              <summary><h3>When should gyms restock cleaning supplies for fall?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>In the first three weeks of August. September is the year's second-largest membership surge and wipe consumption typically rises 20–40%. Ordering early secures inventory ahead of peak demand and freight congestion.</p></div>
            </details><details class="wpx-qa" >
              <summary><h3>How many gym wipes does a facility need per month?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>Budget 1.5–2.5 wipes per member check-in. At 400 check-ins per day that is roughly 18,000–30,000 wipes monthly, about 26–43 bulk refill rolls of 700 count. Add 25% buffer for September.</p></div>
            </details><details class="wpx-qa" >
              <summary><h3>Do gyms need EPA-registered disinfecting wipes?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>Yes, for any surface where you claim germ kill. Only EPA-registered disinfectants can legally make kill claims in the US. Most facilities run a two-product system: plant-based wipes for members and <a href="/collections/sanitizing-disinfectant-wipes-for-everyday-use">EPA-registered disinfecting wipes</a> for staff cycles.</p></div>
            </details><details class="wpx-qa" >
              <summary><h3>What is the hidden cost of running out of gym wipes?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>Displaced staff labor, faster equipment corrosion, member complaints and negative reviews, and emergency purchases at 2–3× bulk cost. A single canceled membership usually exceeds the annual cost of keeping one dispenser stocked.</p></div>
            </details><details class="wpx-qa" >
              <summary><h3>How do multi-location gym chains standardize cleaning supplies?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>Standardize one wipe format and one dispenser spec across all clubs, set par levels by club size tier, and place a single consolidated bulk order each quarter. This produces comparable per-club cost, portable staff training, and consistent member experience.</p></div>
            </details><details class="wpx-qa" >
              <summary><h3>How many wipe dispensers does a gym need?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>Plan one dispenser per 800–1,000 sq ft, plus dedicated units at cardio rows, free-weight areas, functional turf, studio entrances, and locker room doors. No member should walk more than 15 feet to reach a wipe — compare formats in the <a href="/collections/wipe-dispensers">dispensers collection</a>.</p></div>
            </details><details class="wpx-qa" >
              <summary><h3>Are plant-based wipes safe for gym equipment upholstery?</h3></summary>
              <div class="wpx-qa-body"><p>Yes. Alcohol-free, plant-based wipes remove sweat and body oils without drying or cracking vinyl and are appropriate for daily member use. Reserve stronger disinfectants for staff-led cleaning of hard, high-touch surfaces.</p></div>
            </details></div>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

<script>
      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

        <p>If you run a gym or manage a fitness facility, wipes are part of your everyday operations. The way you provide them, however, can vary depending on your facility's layout, traffic, available space, and how members and staff use different areas.</p>

<p>Two common approaches are <strong>standalone wipe buckets</strong> and <strong>dispenser + refill systems</strong>. Both can provide convenient access to wipes, but they offer different advantages depending on where they are placed and how frequently they are used.</p>

<p>A bucket can be a practical choice when <strong>portability, flexible placement, or standalone access</strong> is important. A dispenser + refill system can be a strong fit when you want a <strong>dedicated wipe station, consistent placement, and high-volume refill capacity</strong>.</p>

<p>The right choice is not simply about which system is better. It is about <strong>which system fits each area of your facility best</strong>. Some gyms may benefit from using buckets in certain spaces and dispensers in others.</p>

<p>This guide compares both options across <strong>cost per wipe, placement, portability, refill capacity, usage patterns, and operating needs</strong>, helping you build a wipe setup around the way your facility actually works.</p>

        <div class="snippet">
          <p><strong>Quick answer:</strong> Choose based on the job each wipe station needs to perform. <strong>Buckets</strong> are well suited to flexible, portable, or independently placed wipe access. <strong>Dispenser + refill systems</strong> are well suited to dedicated stations, high-traffic areas, and locations where consistent wipe access is part of the facility layout.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="stats">
          <div class="stat"><div class="s-num">700</div><div class="s-label">Wipes per high-yield refill roll</div></div>
          <div class="stat"><div class="s-num">2</div><div class="s-label">System options to compare</div></div>

        <h2 id="wai-s1-template--23154820514035__blog_ai_002_3FhwqF">The Real Question Isn't Price — It's Cost Per Wipe</h2>
        <p>A bucket and a dispenser + refill system have different pricing structures, so comparing only the upfront price does not tell the whole story. The more useful metric is <strong>cost per wipe</strong> — the amount you spend for each wipe available for use.</p>

<p>When comparing the two systems, consider factors such as <strong>number of wipes, refill or replacement frequency, placement, usage patterns, and ongoing operating needs</strong>. Depending on how your facility operates, one system may offer a better fit for certain areas while the other may work better elsewhere.</p>

<p>Think of the decision as part of your overall facility setup: a <strong>dispenser + refill system</strong> combines a reusable dispenser with recurring refill rolls, while a <strong>bucket system</strong> provides wipes in a self-contained format that can be placed and moved as needed. Both approaches can support convenient wipe access, with different considerations for cost and day-to-day use.</p>

        <div class="callout callout--tip">
          <span class="c-ic" aria-hidden="true">💡</span>
          <p><strong>Operator tip:</strong> Before comparing options, use the same metric for both systems: <strong>total wipe cost ÷ total wipes available</strong>. Then consider placement, usage frequency, portability, refill needs, and other operational factors to determine which option fits each area of your facility.</p>
        </div>

        <h2 id="wai-s2-template--23154820514035__blog_ai_002_3FhwqF">How to Calculate Your True Cost Per Wipe</h2>
        <p>The formula is simple, but a complete comparison should look beyond the upfront purchase price. To understand the ongoing cost of each system, consider the wipes purchased, how they are used, and the operational factors associated with keeping them available.</p>
        <div class="snippet">
          <p><strong>True cost per wipe formula:</strong> (Annual wipe purchases + applicable restock labor costs + applicable waste costs + equipment cost allocation) ÷ total wipes used. Using the same calculation for both a bucket system and a dispenser + refill system gives you a consistent basis for comparing their ongoing costs.</p>
        </div>

        <h3>The four inputs to consider</h3>
        <ul class="list">
          <li><strong>Purchase cost</strong> — what you pay for wipes in bucket formats versus dispenser refill rolls.</li>
          <li><strong>Restock labor</strong> — how often staff replace or refill wipe containers and how much time each task requires.</li>
          <li><strong>Waste</strong> — wipes that dry out, are over-pulled, or remain unused when a container is replaced or discarded.</li>
          <li><strong>Equipment cost</strong> — the dispenser investment distributed across its expected period of use.</li>
        </ul>

        <h2 id="wai-s3-template--23154820514035__blog_ai_002_3FhwqF">Buckets: Where buckets make sense</h2>
        <p>Standalone wipe buckets are the default for a reason — they are portable, require zero installation, and are easy to drop into any corner. For a brand-new studio, a pop-up location, or a small facility with light traffic, they can be the right call.</p>
        <h3>Where buckets make sense</h3>
        <ul class="list">
          <li><strong>Low-traffic or new facilities</strong> where wipe usage is still being established or may vary by area.</li>
  <li><strong>Portability needs</strong> when wipes may need to move between rooms, courts, training areas, or other spaces.</li>
  <li><strong>Flexible placement</strong> where a dedicated dispenser location is not necessary or where the layout changes frequently.</li>
  <li><strong>Zero-install setups</strong> where wall mounting or a floor-standing dispenser is not the preferred option.</li>
  <li><strong>Standalone wipe stations</strong> where a self-contained container provides the right combination of wipes and storage for the space.</li>
</ul>
        <h3>What to consider when choosing buckets</h3>
        <ul class="list">
          <li><strong>Wipe volume</strong> — consider how many wipes each area uses and how frequently containers will need to be replaced.</li>
  <li><strong>Placement</strong> — evaluate whether buckets can be positioned where members and staff can easily access them.</li>
  <li><strong>Portability</strong> — consider how often wipes need to be moved or repositioned throughout the facility.</li>
  <li><strong>Ongoing supply needs</strong> — account for the container size, replacement frequency, and total wipe usage when planning inventory.</li>
</ul>
        <div class="callout callout--warn">
          <span class="c-ic" aria-hidden="true">⚠</span>
          <p><strong>Operator tip:</strong> Before choosing a bucket for every area, map your facility's wipe demand. Buckets can be particularly useful in locations where flexibility and portability matter, while a dispenser + refill system may be more suitable for fixed, high-traffic wipe stations.</p>
        </div>

        <h2 id="wai-s4-template--23154820514035__blog_ai_002_3FhwqF">Dispenser Systems: Where They Fit Best</h2>
        <p>A <strong>dispenser + refill system</strong> separates the reusable dispenser from the wipe supply. The dispenser provides a dedicated access point, while high-count refill rolls provide the recurring wipe supply. This format can be particularly useful for facilities that want consistent wipe stations in fixed locations and a streamlined approach to replenishment.</p>
        <h3>Why dispensers can be a strong fit</h3>
        <ul class="list">
          <li><strong>High-volume wipe stations</strong> — high-count refill rolls can support areas where wipes are used frequently throughout the day.</li>
          <li><strong>Dedicated placement</strong> — wall-mounted and floor-standing options make it easier to establish consistent wipe stations throughout a facility.</li>
          <li><strong>Refill capacity</strong> — larger refill rolls can reduce the frequency of supply changes depending on usage.</li>
          <li><strong>Consistent presentation</strong> — a dedicated dispenser creates a defined wipe station that can integrate into the facility's layout.</li>
          <li><strong>Fixed high-traffic areas</strong> — dispensers can work well near cardio equipment, strength areas, entrances, studios, and other locations where consistent wipe access is important.</li>
        </ul>

        <h3>What to consider when choosing a dispenser system</h3>
        <ul class="list">
          <li><strong>Location</strong> — determine whether wall-mounted or floor-standing placement works best for each area.</li>
          <li><strong>Traffic and usage</strong> — estimate how frequently each station will be used to select an appropriate refill capacity.</li>
          <li><strong>Installation</strong> — consider the available wall or floor space and the preferred placement of each station.</li>
          <li><strong>Refill management</strong> — plan inventory around the number of stations, refill capacity, and expected wipe usage.</li>
        </ul>

<p>Both systems can provide convenient wipe access. The right fit depends on your facility's layout, traffic, usage patterns, placement needs, and operating preferences.</p>

        <h2 id="wai-s6-template--23154820514035__blog_ai_002_3FhwqF">Wall Mounted vs. Floor Standing Dispensers</h2>

<p>Once you choose a dispenser + refill system, the next decision is placement format. Both <strong>wall-mounted gym wipe dispensers</strong> and <strong>floor-standing wipe dispensers</strong> provide dedicated wipe access. The right option depends on your floor plan, available space, installation preferences, and traffic flow.</p>

<h3>Choose wall mounted if…</h3>

<p>You want to make efficient use of floor space and create fixed wipe stations near equipment clusters, mirrors, entrances, or other frequently used areas. Wall-mounted units can be a good fit for weight floors, functional zones, and locations where a permanent station makes sense.</p>

<h3>Choose floor standing if…</h3>

<p>You prefer a freestanding station that can be positioned without wall mounting. Floor-standing units can work well on open cardio floors, studio spaces, entrances, and other areas where a visible, accessible wipe station is needed.</p>

<div class="checklist">
  <h3>Dispenser Placement Checklist</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><span class="check-ic" aria-hidden="true">✓</span> <span><strong>Entrance & exit</strong> — consider placing a wipe station where members can easily access it as they enter or leave.</span></li>
    <li><span class="check-ic" aria-hidden="true">✓</span> <span><strong>Free-weight & machine zones</strong> — position stations near areas where equipment is frequently shared.</span></li>
    <li><span class="check-ic" aria-hidden="true">✓</span> <span><strong>Cardio floor</strong> — place stations within convenient reach of equipment clusters and common walkways.</span></li>
    <li><span class="check-ic" aria-hidden="true">✓</span> <span><strong>Studio & functional rooms</strong> — consider floor-standing or wall-mounted options based on the room's layout and how often it changes.</span></li>
    <li><span class="check-ic" aria-hidden="true">✓</span> <span><strong>Refill visibility</strong> — position units where staff can easily monitor supply levels and plan refills.</span></li>
  </ul>
</div>

<h2 id="wai-s7-template--23154820514035__blog_ai_002_3FhwqF">How to Build Your Wipe System</h2>

<p>The right wipe setup does not have to use the same format in every area. Start with your facility's layout and usage patterns, then choose buckets, dispensers, or a combination of both based on the needs of each zone.</p>

<ul class="list">
  <li><strong>Map your zones</strong> — identify high-traffic areas, equipment clusters, studios, entrances, and spaces where wipe access is needed.</li>
  <li><strong>Choose the right format</strong> — use buckets where portability and flexible placement matter, and dispensers where dedicated wipe stations are preferred.</li>
  <li><strong>Select your dispenser format</strong> — choose wall mounted for fixed stations or floor standing for freestanding placement.</li>
  <li><strong>Plan your wipe supply</strong> — match bucket sizes or refill capacity to the expected usage of each area.</li>
  <li><strong>Set a restock cadence</strong> — monitor usage and establish a replenishment routine that keeps wipes available when needed.</li>
  <li><strong>Review the system over time</strong> — adjust placement, quantities, and formats as traffic patterns and facility needs change.</li>
</ul>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

<script>
(function() {
  class ChecklistTrackeradvnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg extends HTMLElement {
    constructor() {
      super();

      this.storageKey = this.dataset.storageKey;

      this.progressFill = this.querySelector('[data-progress-fill]');
      this.progressText = this.querySelector('[data-progress-text]');
      this.progressPercent = this.querySelector('[data-progress-percent]');

      this.stickyScore = this.querySelector('[data-sticky-score]');
      this.ringProgress = this.querySelector('[data-ring-progress]');
      this.ringPercent = this.querySelector('[data-ring-percent]');
      this.stickyCompleted = this.querySelector('[data-sticky-completed]');

      this.checkboxes = this.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');
      this.categories = this.querySelectorAll('[data-category]');
    }

    connectedCallback() {
      this.loadState();
      this.setupEventListeners();

      // abrir primeira categoria
      const firstCategory = this.querySelector('[data-category]');
      if (firstCategory) {
        firstCategory.classList.add('open');

        const button = firstCategory.querySelector('.ai-cat-head-advnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg');
        if (button) button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }

      this.updateProgress();
      this.handleStickyBar();
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
      // CHECKBOX EVENTS
      this.checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
        checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => {
          this.saveState();
          this.updateProgress();
        });
      });

      // CATEGORY TOGGLE
      this.categories.forEach((category) => {
        const button = category.querySelector('.ai-cat-head-advnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg');
        if (!button) return;

        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const isOpen = category.classList.contains('open');
          category.classList.toggle('open');
          button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isOpen));
        });
      });

      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => this.handleStickyBar());
    }

    loadState() {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
        if (!saved) return;

        const state = JSON.parse(saved);

        this.checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
          const itemId = checkbox.dataset.item;
          if (state[itemId]) checkbox.checked = true;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to load checklist state:', e);
      }
    }

    saveState() {
      try {
        const state = {};

        this.checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
          const itemId = checkbox.dataset.item;
          state[itemId] = checkbox.checked;
        });

        localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(state));
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to save checklist state:', e);
      }
    }

    updateProgress() {
      const total = this.checkboxes.length;
      const completed = Array.from(this.checkboxes).filter(cb => cb.checked).length;

      const percent = total ? Math.round((completed / total) * 100) : 0;

      let level = 'High Risk';
      if (percent >= 25) level = 'Moderate';
      if (percent >= 50) level = 'Ready';
      if (percent >= 80) level = 'Excellent';

      const readinessLevel = this.querySelector('[data-readiness-level]');
      if (readinessLevel) {
        readinessLevel.textContent = level;
      }

      if (this.progressFill) {
        this.progressFill.style.width = percent + '%';
      }

      if (this.progressText) {
        this.progressText.textContent = `${completed} of ${total} completed`;
      }

      if (this.progressPercent) {
        this.progressPercent.textContent = percent + '%';
      }

      if (this.ringPercent) {
        this.ringPercent.textContent = percent + '%';
      }

      if (this.stickyCompleted) {
        this.stickyCompleted.textContent = `${completed} of ${total} completed`;
      }

      if (this.ringProgress) {
        const circumference = 125.6;
        const offset = circumference - (percent / 100) * circumference;
        this.ringProgress.style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
      }

      // CATEGORY SCORES + DASHBOARD

this.categories.forEach((category) => {

  const categoryId = category.dataset.category;

  const checkboxes =
    category.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');

  const totalItems = checkboxes.length;

  const checkedItems =
    Array.from(checkboxes).filter(cb => cb.checked).length;

  const scoreElement =
    category.querySelector(
      `[data-category-score="${categoryId}"]`
    );

  if(scoreElement){
    scoreElement.textContent =
      `${checkedItems} of ${totalItems} checked`;
  }

  // DASHBOARD COUNT

  const dashCount =
    this.querySelector(
      `[data-dashboard-cat-count="${categoryId}"]`
    );

  if(dashCount){
    dashCount.textContent =
      `${checkedItems}/${totalItems}`;
  }

  // DASHBOARD BAR

  const dashBar =
    this.querySelector(
      `[data-dashboard-cat-bar="${categoryId}"]`
    );

  if(dashBar){

    const catPercent =
      totalItems
        ? Math.round(
            (checkedItems / totalItems) * 100
          )
        : 0;

    dashBar.style.width =
      catPercent + '%';
  }
});

// BIG SCORE

const dashboardScore =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-dashboard-score]'
  );

if(dashboardScore){
  dashboardScore.textContent =
    percent + '%';
}

// LEVEL

const dashboardLevel =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-dashboard-level]'
  );

const dashboardDescription =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-dashboard-description]'
  );

if(dashboardLevel){

  dashboardLevel.textContent = level;

  if(level === 'High Risk'){

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'Your operation may struggle during major hospitality events.';

  } else if(level === 'Moderate'){

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'You are making progress but there are still gaps to address.';

  } else if(level === 'Ready'){

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'Your restaurant is well prepared for seasonal demand.';

  } else {

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'Excellent. Your operation is fully prepared.';
  }
}

// CELEBRATION

const celebration =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-celebration]'
  );

  // ==============================
// SUGGESTED NEXT STEPS
// ==============================

const suggestions = this.querySelector('[data-dashboard-suggestions]');
const allCompleteText = "All items complete. Great work.";
const defaultEmptyText = "Start checking items to receive suggestions.";

if (suggestions) {

  suggestions.innerHTML = '';

  // ===================================
  // EMPTY STATE (nenhum item marcado)
  // ===================================

  if (completed === 0) {

    suggestions.innerHTML = `
      <p class="ai-dashboard-empty-advnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg">
        ${defaultEmptyText}
      </p>
    `;

  }

  // ===================================
  // 100%
  // ===================================

  else if (percent === 100) {

    suggestions.innerHTML = `
      <p class="ai-dashboard-empty-advnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg">
        ${allCompleteText}
      </p>
    `;

  }

  // ===================================
  // SUGGESTIONS
  // ===================================

  else {

    this.categories.forEach(category => {

      const categoryTitle =
        category.querySelector('h3')?.textContent || '';

      const items =
        category.querySelectorAll('.ai-check-item-advnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg');

      for (const item of items) {

        const checkbox =
          item.querySelector('input');

        if (!checkbox.checked) {

          const text =
            item.querySelector('span').textContent;

          suggestions.insertAdjacentHTML(
            'beforeend',
            `
            <div class="sugg-item">
              <span class="arrow">→</span>

              <div>
                <strong>${categoryTitle}</strong>
                <span>${text}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            `
          );

          // Apenas uma sugestão por categoria
          break;
        }

      }

    });

  }

}

if(celebration){

  if(percent >= 80){

    celebration.classList.add('show');

  }else{

    celebration.classList.remove('show');
  }
}

// ==========================
// DASHBOARD 2
// ==========================


const dash2Percent =
this.querySelector('[data-dashboard2-percent]');


const dash2Fill =
this.querySelector('[data-dashboard2-fill]');


const dash2Grade =
this.querySelector('[data-dashboard2-grade]');



if(dash2Percent){

dash2Percent.textContent =
percent + '%';

}



if(dash2Fill){

dash2Fill.style.width =
percent + '%';

}



if(dash2Grade){


let grade='F';


if(percent >= 95){

grade='A+';

}
else if(percent >=80){

grade='A';

}
else if(percent >=60){

grade='B';

}
else if(percent >=40){

grade='C';

}
else if(percent >=20){

grade='D';

}



dash2Grade.textContent =
grade;



if(percent >=80){

dash2Grade.classList.add('good');

}else{

dash2Grade.classList.remove('good');

}


}

// GLOBAL EVENT

window.dispatchEvent(
  new CustomEvent('checklistUpdated',{
    detail:{
      percent,
      completed,
      total,
      level
    }
  })
);
}

    handleStickyBar() {
      if (!this.stickyScore) return;

      const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
      const isScrolledPast = rect.bottom < window.innerHeight;

      if (isScrolledPast) {
        this.stickyScore.classList.add('show');
      } else {
        this.stickyScore.classList.remove('show');
      }
    }
  }

  customElements.define(
    'checklist-tracker-advnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg',
    ChecklistTrackeradvnrbtfpzuhml0n0zaigenblocke6e2ccdhflqfg
  );
})();
</script>

      this.totalSteps = 5;
      this.answers = {};

    }


    connectedCallback() {

      this.steps = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-step-azkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');

      this.progressBar = this.querySelector('#quizProgressazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');

      this.progressText = this.querySelector('#quizProgressTextazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');

      this.backBtn = this.querySelector('#quizBackazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');

      this.nextBtn = this.querySelector('#quizNextazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');

      this.restartBtn = this.querySelector('#quizRestartazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');

      this.form = this.querySelector('#quizFormazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');

      this.resultDiv = this.querySelector('#quizResultazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');


      this.initProgressBar();

      this.attachEventListeners();

      this.updateButtons();

    }



    initProgressBar() {

      if(!this.progressBar) return;


      for(let i = 0; i < this.totalSteps; i++){

        const bar = document.createElement('div');

        this.progressBar.appendChild(bar);

      }


      this.updateProgressBar();

    }



    attachEventListeners(){


      if(this.backBtn){

        this.backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.goBack();

        });

      }



      if(this.nextBtn){

        this.nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.goNext();

        });

      }



      if(this.restartBtn){

        this.restartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.restartQuiz();

        });

      }



      this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-azkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr')
      .forEach(option => {


        option.addEventListener('click', (e) => {


          e.preventDefault();


          const input = option.querySelector('input');


          const step = option.closest('.ai-quiz-step-azkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');



          step.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-azkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr')
          .forEach(opt => {

            opt.classList.remove('selected');

          });



          option.classList.add('selected');


          if(input){

            input.checked = true;

          }



          this.nextBtn.disabled = false;



        });


      });


    }




    updateProgressBar(){


      const bars = this.progressBar.querySelectorAll('div');


      bars.forEach((bar,index)=>{


        if(index < this.currentStep){

          bar.classList.add('done');

        } else {

          bar.classList.remove('done');

        }


      });



      if(this.progressText){

        this.progressText.textContent =
        `Question ${this.currentStep + 1} of ${this.totalSteps}`;

      }


    }




    goBack(){


      if(this.currentStep > 0){


        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.remove('active');


        this.currentStep--;


        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.add('active');


        this.updateProgressBar();

        this.updateButtons();


      }


    }





    goNext(){


      const currentQuestion =
      this.steps[this.currentStep]
      .querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');



      if(!currentQuestion){

        return;

      }



      this.answers['q' + (this.currentStep + 1)] =
      parseInt(currentQuestion.value);



      if(this.currentStep < this.totalSteps - 1){



        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.remove('active');



        this.currentStep++;



        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.add('active');



        this.updateProgressBar();


        this.updateButtons();



      } else {


        this.showResults();


      }


    }





    updateButtons(){


      if(this.backBtn){

        this.backBtn.disabled =
        this.currentStep === 0;

      }



      const currentAnswer =
      this.steps[this.currentStep]
      .querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');



      if(this.nextBtn){

        this.nextBtn.disabled =
        !currentAnswer;


        if(this.currentStep === this.totalSteps - 1){

          this.nextBtn.textContent =
          'See results';

        } else {

          this.nextBtn.textContent =
          'Next';

        }

      }


    }

        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/prompt_9.3.png?v=1783625230';


        resultLink =
        'https://wipex.co/products/isopropyl-alcohol-70-ipa-wipes-single-sachet-100ct-dispenser-box';


      }

      else if(total <= 11){


        resultTitle =
        'Office Essentials Bundle';


        resultText =
        'Ideal for mid-size offices with shared workstations, break rooms, and moderate daily traffic. Stock every desk cluster and common area with multi-surface wipes built for consistent, everyday cleaning routines.';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/prompt_9.4_65549338-304b-4057-8374-6b5f8dec4386.jpg?v=1783626468';


        resultLink =
        'https://wipex.co/products/wipex-70-alcohol-multi-surface-cleaning-wipes-75ct-canister';


      }

      else {


        resultTitle =
        'Enterprise Facility Solution';


        resultText =
        'Comprehensive coverage for large offices, multi-floor buildings, and high-traffic facilities. Reduce restocking frequency with bulk-format wipes designed to support cleaning routines across every shared space, department, and floor.';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/prompt_9.jpg?v=1783626466';


        resultLink =
        'https://wipex.co/products/isopropyl-alcohol-wipes-bulk-1000-count';

      this.querySelector('#resultTitleazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');


      const text =
      this.querySelector('#resultTextazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');


      const link =
      this.querySelector('#resultLinkazkllcmrpylhsterrvaigenblockf7b6d97drfybr');




      if(image && resultImage){

        image.src = resultImage;

      }


      if(title){

        title.textContent = resultTitle;

      }

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>
