      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

      constructor() {
        super();
        this.currentSlide = 1;
        this.autoplayInterval = null;
        this.autoplayDelay = 5000;
      }

      connectedCallback() {
        this.slides = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-banner-carousel__slide-aathgvxpjyxe4b3ngtaigenblocka83cc5d9dlgce');
        this.navButtons = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-banner-carousel__nav-button-aathgvxpjyxe4b3ngtaigenblocka83cc5d9dlgce');
        this.prevButton = this.querySelector('.ai-banner-carousel__arrow-aathgvxpjyxe4b3ngtaigenblocka83cc5d9dlgce--prev');
        this.nextButton = this.querySelector('.ai-banner-carousel__arrow-aathgvxpjyxe4b3ngtaigenblocka83cc5d9dlgce--next');

        if (this.slides.length > 1) {

          this.startAutoplay();

      setupEventListeners() {

          this.prevButton.addEventListener('click', () => {

            this.previousSlide();
            this.startAutoplay();
          });
        }

        if (this.nextButton) {
          this.nextButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
            this.stopAutoplay();
            this.nextSlide();
            this.startAutoplay();
          });
        }

        this.navButtons.forEach((button) => {
          button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            this.stopAutoplay();
            const slideNumber = parseInt(button.getAttribute('data-slide'));
            this.goToSlide(slideNumber);
            this.startAutoplay();
          });
        });

        this.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          this.stopAutoplay();
        });

        this.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
          this.startAutoplay();
        });
      }

      goToSlide(slideNumber) {
        this.slides.forEach((slide) => {
          slide.classList.remove('active');
        });

        this.navButtons.forEach((button) => {
          button.classList.remove('active');

        const targetSlide = this.querySelector(`[data-slide="${slideNumber}"]`);

        if (nextSlideNumber > this.slides.length) {

<script>
(function () {

  const elementName = 'readiness-score-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt';

  if (customElements.get(elementName)) return;

  class ReadinessScore extends HTMLElement {

    constructor() {
      super();
      this.checkedCount = 0;
      this.totalItems = 0;
    }

    connectedCallback() {
      this.checkItems = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-check-item-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');
      this.progressFill = this.querySelector('#progress-fill-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');
      this.scoreDisplay = this.querySelector('#score-display-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');
      this.scoreResult = this.querySelector('#score-result-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');
      this.resultMessage = this.querySelector('#result-message-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');
      this.progressTrack = this.querySelector('.ai-progress-track-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');

      if (!this.checkItems.length) return;

      this.totalItems = this.checkItems.length;

      // 🔥 IMPORTANT: sincroniza estado inicial baseado no DOM real
      this.checkedCount = 0;

      this.checkItems.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.classList.contains('checked')) {
          this.checkedCount++;
          const box = item.querySelector('.ai-check-box-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');
          if (box) box.innerHTML = '✓';
          item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
        } else {
          item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
        }
      });

      this.bindEvents();
      this.updateProgress();
    }

    bindEvents() {
      // ✅ delegation mais estável no Shopify
      this.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const item = e.target.closest('.ai-check-item-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');
        if (!item || !this.contains(item)) return;
        this.toggle(item);
      });

      this.checkItems.forEach((item) => {

        item.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.toggle(item);
          }
        });

        item.addEventListener('focus', () => {
          item.style.outline = '2px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.4)';
          item.style.outlineOffset = '2px';
        });

        item.addEventListener('blur', () => {
          item.style.outline = 'none';
        });

      });
    }

    toggle(item) {
      const isChecked = item.classList.contains('checked');
      const box = item.querySelector('.ai-check-box-arzlyatnoykz2dzkwuaigenblock3b1a28cd6pxwt');

      if (isChecked) {
        item.classList.remove('checked');
        item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
        if (box) box.innerHTML = '';
        this.checkedCount = Math.max(0, this.checkedCount - 1);
      } else {
        item.classList.add('checked');
        item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
        if (box) box.innerHTML = '✓';
        this.checkedCount = Math.min(this.totalItems, this.checkedCount + 1);
      }

      this.updateProgress();
    }

    updateProgress() {

  const messages = {
    1: "Needs Preparation — You've got a start. Address your gaps now — festival crowds won't give you time to figure it out on-site.",
    2: "Needs Preparation — You're partway there. Lock in your floor plan and wipe supply before you commit to any festival dates.",
    3: "Almost Ready — Good foundation. A couple of gaps remain — close them before your first event and you'll be in solid shape.",
    4: "Almost Ready — Very close. One more item and you're fully prepared. Check what's unchecked and address it this week.",
    5: "🎉 Festival Ready! Your operation is prepared for the 2026 food festival season. Time to focus on the food — your cleaning plan is dialed in."
  };

  const total = this.totalItems;
  const checked = this.checkedCount;

  const percentage = total === 0 ? 0 : (checked / total) * 100;

  // progress bar
  if (this.progressFill) {
    this.progressFill.style.width = percentage + '%';
    if (this.progressTrack) {
      this.progressTrack.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(percentage));
    }
  }

  // counter
  if (this.scoreDisplay) {
    this.scoreDisplay.textContent = `${checked} / ${total}`;
  }

  if (!this.scoreResult || !this.resultMessage) return;

  // SCORE MAPPING (REGRAS QUE VOCÊ PEDIU)
  let message = '';
  let show = false;

  if (checked === 0) {
  show = false;
}

else if (checked === 1) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[1];
}

else if (checked === 2) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[2];
}

else if (checked === 3) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[3];
}

else if (checked < total) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[4];
}

else if (checked === total) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[5];
}

  if (show) {
    this.scoreResult.classList.add('visible');
    this.resultMessage.textContent = message;
  } else {
    this.scoreResult.classList.remove('visible');
  }
}
  }

  customElements.define(elementName, ReadinessScore);

})();
</script>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

<script>
(function() {

  class QuizComponentayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj extends HTMLElement {

    constructor() {

      super();

      this.currentStep = 0;
      this.totalSteps = 5;
      this.answers = {};

    }


    connectedCallback() {

      this.steps = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-step-ayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');

      this.progressBar = this.querySelector('#quizProgressayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');

      this.progressText = this.querySelector('#quizProgressTextayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');

      this.backBtn = this.querySelector('#quizBackayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');

      this.nextBtn = this.querySelector('#quizNextayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');

      this.restartBtn = this.querySelector('#quizRestartayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');

      this.form = this.querySelector('#quizFormayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');

      this.resultDiv = this.querySelector('#quizResultayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');


      this.initProgressBar();

      this.attachEventListeners();

      this.updateButtons();

    }



    initProgressBar() {

      if(!this.progressBar) return;


      for(let i = 0; i < this.totalSteps; i++){

        const bar = document.createElement('div');

        this.progressBar.appendChild(bar);

      }


      this.updateProgressBar();

    }



    attachEventListeners(){


      if(this.backBtn){

        this.backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.goBack();

        });

      }



      if(this.nextBtn){

        this.nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.goNext();

        });

      }



      if(this.restartBtn){

        this.restartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.restartQuiz();

        });

      }



      this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-ayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj')
      .forEach(option => {


        option.addEventListener('click', (e) => {


          e.preventDefault();


          const input = option.querySelector('input');


          const step = option.closest('.ai-quiz-step-ayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');



          step.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-ayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj')
          .forEach(opt => {

            opt.classList.remove('selected');

          });



          option.classList.add('selected');


          if(input){

            input.checked = true;

          }



          this.nextBtn.disabled = false;



        });


      });


    }




    updateProgressBar(){


      const bars = this.progressBar.querySelectorAll('div');


      bars.forEach((bar,index)=>{


        if(index < this.currentStep){

          bar.classList.add('done');

        } else {

          bar.classList.remove('done');

        }


      });



      if(this.progressText){

        this.progressText.textContent =
        `Question ${this.currentStep + 1} of ${this.totalSteps}`;

      }


    }




    goBack(){


      if(this.currentStep > 0){


        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.remove('active');


        this.currentStep--;


        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.add('active');


        this.updateProgressBar();

        this.updateButtons();


      }


    }





    goNext(){


      const currentQuestion =
      this.steps[this.currentStep]
      .querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');



      if(!currentQuestion){

        return;

      }



      this.answers['q' + (this.currentStep + 1)] =
      parseInt(currentQuestion.value);



      if(this.currentStep < this.totalSteps - 1){



        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.remove('active');



        this.currentStep++;



        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.add('active');



        this.updateProgressBar();


        this.updateButtons();



      } else {


        this.showResults();


      }


    }





    updateButtons(){


      if(this.backBtn){

        this.backBtn.disabled =
        this.currentStep === 0;

      }



      const currentAnswer =
      this.steps[this.currentStep]
      .querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');



      if(this.nextBtn){

        this.nextBtn.disabled =
        !currentAnswer;


        if(this.currentStep === this.totalSteps - 1){

          this.nextBtn.textContent =
          'See results';

        } else {

          this.nextBtn.textContent =
          'Next';

        }

      }


    }







    showResults(){


      const total =
      Object.values(this.answers)
      .reduce((sum,val)=>sum + val,0);



      let resultTitle = '';

      let resultText = '';

      let resultImage = '';

      let resultLink = '';




      if(total <= 7){


        resultTitle =
        'Starter Kit';


        resultText =
        'Best for boutique studios and smaller facilities';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Wipex_Natural_Gym_Wipes_Starter_Bundle__Dispenser_Bucket_with_Refill__Plant-Based_Wipes_for_Fitness_Equipment-product_type-fitness-bucket-starter-bundle_c0b570a62162f30f540ca4892ce52b8b.jpg?v=1767023470';


        resultLink =
        '/products/fitness-bucket-starter-bundle';


      }

      else if(total <= 11){


        resultTitle =
        'Gym Bundle';


        resultText =
        'Best for gyms and mid-size studios';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/WallDispenser-4pk-LAVpb_1aa337e6-7d03-41e1-ac96-6f9b88490145.jpg?v=1755024868';


        resultLink =
        'https://wipex.co/products/plant-based-bulk-rolls?variant=43863856087283';


      }

      else {


        resultTitle =
        'Bulk Gym Refill Roll';


        resultText =
        'Built for continuous cleaning stations throughout a busy facility.';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Wipex_700_Plant-Based_Gym_Wipes_Bulk_Refill_Roll__Natural_Fitness_Equipment_Wipes-product_type-plant-based-bulk-rolls_93e4f1e3e1137cf9a5d4aa3aca43949f.jpg?v=1767026924';


        resultLink =
        'https://wipex.co/products/plant-based-bulk-rolls?variant=43863855988979';


      }




      const image =
      this.querySelector('#resultImageayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');


      const title =
      this.querySelector('#resultTitleayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');


      const text =
      this.querySelector('#resultTextayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');


      const link =
      this.querySelector('#resultLinkayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj');




      if(image && resultImage){

        image.src = resultImage;

      }


      if(title){

        title.textContent = resultTitle;

      }


      if(text){

        text.textContent = resultText;

      }


      if(link){

        link.href = resultLink;

      }




      this.form.style.display = 'none';


      this.resultDiv.classList.add('active');


    }







    restartQuiz(){


      this.currentStep = 0;

      this.answers = {};



      this.resultDiv.classList.remove('active');


      this.form.style.display = 'block';



      this.steps.forEach((step,index)=>{


        step.classList.toggle(
          'active',
          index === 0
        );


      });




      this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-ayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj')
      .forEach(option=>{


        option.classList.remove('selected');


        const input =
        option.querySelector('input');


        if(input){

          input.checked = false;

        }


      });



      this.updateProgressBar();


      this.updateButtons();


    }



  }




  customElements.define(
    'quiz-component-ayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj',
    QuizComponentayxd4uxkvl0dwmtbfnaigenblockf7b6d97rmzvlj
  );


})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {

  const elementName = 'readiness-score-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg';

  if (customElements.get(elementName)) return;

  class ReadinessScore extends HTMLElement {

    constructor() {
      super();
      this.checkedCount = 0;
      this.totalItems = 0;
    }

    connectedCallback() {
      this.checkItems = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-check-item-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');
      this.progressFill = this.querySelector('#progress-fill-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');
      this.scoreDisplay = this.querySelector('#score-display-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');
      this.scoreResult = this.querySelector('#score-result-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');
      this.resultMessage = this.querySelector('#result-message-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');
      this.progressTrack = this.querySelector('.ai-progress-track-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');

      if (!this.checkItems.length) return;

      this.totalItems = this.checkItems.length;

      // 🔥 IMPORTANT: sincroniza estado inicial baseado no DOM real
      this.checkedCount = 0;

      this.checkItems.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.classList.contains('checked')) {
          this.checkedCount++;
          const box = item.querySelector('.ai-check-box-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');
          if (box) box.innerHTML = '✓';
          item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
        } else {
          item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
        }
      });

      this.bindEvents();
      this.updateProgress();
    }

    bindEvents() {
      // ✅ delegation mais estável no Shopify
      this.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const item = e.target.closest('.ai-check-item-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');
        if (!item || !this.contains(item)) return;
        this.toggle(item);
      });

      this.checkItems.forEach((item) => {

        item.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.toggle(item);
          }
        });

        item.addEventListener('focus', () => {
          item.style.outline = '2px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.4)';
          item.style.outlineOffset = '2px';
        });

        item.addEventListener('blur', () => {
          item.style.outline = 'none';
        });

      });
    }

    toggle(item) {
      const isChecked = item.classList.contains('checked');
      const box = item.querySelector('.ai-check-box-aqvppa2rvq0cxv1o2caigenblock3b1a28cy9bpcg');

      if (isChecked) {
        item.classList.remove('checked');
        item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false');
        if (box) box.innerHTML = '';
        this.checkedCount = Math.max(0, this.checkedCount - 1);
      } else {
        item.classList.add('checked');
        item.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
        if (box) box.innerHTML = '✓';
        this.checkedCount = Math.min(this.totalItems, this.checkedCount + 1);
      }

      this.updateProgress();
    }

    updateProgress() {

  const messages = {
    1: "Needs Preparation — Members are noticing the gaps before you are.",
    2: "Needs Preparation — You're making progress. Strengthen your cleaning routine and keep supplies stocked before the back-to-routine rush begins.",
    3: "Almost Ready — Good foundation. A few gaps remain—close them now to deliver a cleaner, more confident member experience.",
    4: "Almost Ready — You're nearly there. Complete the remaining item this week so your facility is fully prepared for returning members.",
    5: "Your facility is ready to create a cleaner member experience!"
  };

  const total = this.totalItems;
  const checked = this.checkedCount;

  const percentage = total === 0 ? 0 : (checked / total) * 100;

  // progress bar
  if (this.progressFill) {
    this.progressFill.style.width = percentage + '%';
    if (this.progressTrack) {
      this.progressTrack.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(percentage));
    }
  }

  // counter
  if (this.scoreDisplay) {
    this.scoreDisplay.textContent = `${checked} / ${total}`;
  }

  if (!this.scoreResult || !this.resultMessage) return;

  // SCORE MAPPING (REGRAS QUE VOCÊ PEDIU)
  let message = '';
  let show = false;

  if (checked === 0) {
  show = false;
}

else if (checked === 1) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[1];
}

else if (checked === 2) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[2];
}

else if (checked === 3) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[3];
}

else if (checked < total) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[4];
}

else if (checked === total) {
  show = true;
  message = messages[5];
}

  if (show) {
    this.scoreResult.classList.add('visible');
    this.resultMessage.textContent = message;
  } else {
    this.scoreResult.classList.remove('visible');
  }
}
  }

  customElements.define(elementName, ReadinessScore);

})();
</script>

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

  <h2 class="ai-use-cases-title-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">

  </h2>


  
    <div class="ai-use-cases-body-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">Cyclosporiasis is an intestinal illness caused by the microscopic parasite Cyclospora cayetanensis. Here's what's established about how it works, based on CDC clinical guidance.</div>
  

  <div class="ai-use-cases-grid-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">
    
      

      
        <div class="ai-use-case-card-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">

            <h3 class="ai-use-case-card-title-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">How infection happens</h3>
          
          
            <p class="ai-use-case-card-text-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">People become infected by consuming food or water contaminated with feces carrying the parasite. It generally isn't spread person-to-person, because shed oocysts need one to two weeks in the environment to mature before they can infect someone else.</p>
          
        </div>
      
    
      

      
        <div class="ai-use-case-card-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">
          
            <span class="ai-use-case-emoji-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">💡</span>
          
          
            <h3 class="ai-use-case-card-title-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">Who it affects</h3>
          
          
            <p class="ai-use-case-card-text-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">Anyone can be infected, regardless of age. People with weakened immune systems may experience more prolonged or severe symptoms.</p>
          
        </div>
      
    
      

      
        <div class="ai-use-case-card-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">
          
            <span class="ai-use-case-emoji-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">🕒</span>
          
          
            <h3 class="ai-use-case-card-title-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">Incubation & duration</h3>
          
          
            <p class="ai-use-case-card-text-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">Symptoms typically begin about a week after exposure (a range of 2–14 days). Without treatment, illness can last anywhere from a few days to a month or longer, and can relapse after seeming to improve.</p>
          
        </div>
      
    
      

      
        <div class="ai-use-case-card-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">
          
            <span class="ai-use-case-emoji-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">🛡️</span>
          
          
            <h3 class="ai-use-case-card-title-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">Symptoms</h3>
          
          
            <p class="ai-use-case-card-text-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">The most common symptom is watery, sometimes frequent or "explosive," diarrhea.         </div>
      
    
      

      
        <div class="ai-use-case-card-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">
          
            <span class="ai-use-case-emoji-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">☑️</span>
          
          
            <h3 class="ai-use-case-card-title-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">Treatment</h3>
          
          
            <p class="ai-use-case-card-text-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">The standard treatment is a course of the oral antibiotic trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX).             <h3 class="ai-use-case-card-title-arwlssdl3q0zvc0t3baigenblock4b28283weddaq">When to see a doctor</h3>

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {

    entries.forEach((entry) => {

      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
      }

    });

  }, {
    threshold: 0.35
  });

  steps.forEach((step) => {
    observer.observe(step);
  });

});

  (function() {
    class BannerCarouseladeh2bk9pv0x2adfzbaigenblocka83cc5dngardl extends HTMLElement {
      constructor() {
        super();
        this.currentSlide = 1;
        this.autoplayInterval = null;
        this.autoplayDelay = 5000;
      }

      connectedCallback() {
        this.slides = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-banner-carousel__slide-adeh2bk9pv0x2adfzbaigenblocka83cc5dngardl');
        this.navButtons = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-banner-carousel__nav-button-adeh2bk9pv0x2adfzbaigenblocka83cc5dngardl');
        this.prevButton = this.querySelector('.ai-banner-carousel__arrow-adeh2bk9pv0x2adfzbaigenblocka83cc5dngardl--prev');
        this.nextButton = this.querySelector('.ai-banner-carousel__arrow-adeh2bk9pv0x2adfzbaigenblocka83cc5dngardl--next');

        if (this.slides.length > 1) {
          this.setupEventListeners();
          this.startAutoplay();
        }
      }

      setupEventListeners() {
        if (this.prevButton) {
          this.prevButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
            this.stopAutoplay();
            this.previousSlide();
            this.startAutoplay();
          });
        }

        if (this.nextButton) {
          this.nextButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
            this.stopAutoplay();
            this.nextSlide();
            this.startAutoplay();
          });
        }

        this.navButtons.forEach((button) => {
          button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            this.stopAutoplay();
            const slideNumber = parseInt(button.getAttribute('data-slide'));
            this.goToSlide(slideNumber);
            this.startAutoplay();
          });
        });

        this.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          this.stopAutoplay();
        });

        this.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
          this.startAutoplay();
        });
      }

      goToSlide(slideNumber) {
        this.slides.forEach((slide) => {
          slide.classList.remove('active');
        });

        this.navButtons.forEach((button) => {
          button.classList.remove('active');
        });

        const targetSlide = this.querySelector(`[data-slide="${slideNumber}"]`);
        if (targetSlide) {
          targetSlide.classList.add('active');
          this.currentSlide = slideNumber;
        }

        const targetNavButton = this.querySelector(`.ai-banner-carousel__nav-button-adeh2bk9pv0x2adfzbaigenblocka83cc5dngardl[data-slide="${slideNumber}"]`);
        if (targetNavButton) {
          targetNavButton.classList.add('active');
        }
      }

      nextSlide() {
        let nextSlideNumber = this.currentSlide + 1;
        if (nextSlideNumber > this.slides.length) {
          nextSlideNumber = 1;
        }
        this.goToSlide(nextSlideNumber);
      }

      previousSlide() {
        let prevSlideNumber = this.currentSlide - 1;
        if (prevSlideNumber < 1) {
          prevSlideNumber = this.slides.length;
        }
        this.goToSlide(prevSlideNumber);
      }

      startAutoplay() {
        this.stopAutoplay();
        if (this.slides.length > 1) {
          this.autoplayInterval = setInterval(() => {
            this.nextSlide();
          }, this.autoplayDelay);
        }
      }

      stopAutoplay() {
        if (this.autoplayInterval) {
          clearInterval(this.autoplayInterval);
          this.autoplayInterval = null;
        }
      }

      disconnectedCallback() {
        this.stopAutoplay();
      }
    }

<script>
(function() {

class AiChecklistaemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn extends HTMLElement {


constructor(){

super();


this.storageKey = 'checklist-global';


this.tabs = this.querySelectorAll(
'.ai-checklist-tab-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn'
);


this.panels = this.querySelectorAll(
'.ai-checklist-panel-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn'
);


this.checkboxes = this.querySelectorAll(
'.ai-check-item-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn input[type="checkbox"]'
);


this.progressFill =
this.querySelector(
'#progress-fill-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn'
);


this.progressLabel =
this.querySelector(
'#progress-label-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn'
);


this.progressScore =
this.querySelector(
'.ai-progress-score-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn'
);


this.tabCounts =
this.querySelectorAll(
'.ai-tab-count-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn'
);


}





connectedCallback(){


this.loadState();


this.setupTabs();


this.setupCheckboxes();


this.updateAll();


}






/* LOAD SAVED CHECKLIST */


loadState(){


try{


const saved =
localStorage.getItem(
this.storageKey
);



if(saved){


const state =
JSON.parse(saved);



this.checkboxes.forEach(
checkbox=>{


if(state[checkbox.dataset.key]){


checkbox.checked=true;


checkbox
.closest('.ai-check-item-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn')
.classList
.add('done');


}


});


}



}catch(error){

console.log(
'Checklist load error',
error
);

}



}






/* SAVE CHECKLIST */


saveState(){


const state={};


this.checkboxes.forEach(
checkbox=>{


state[checkbox.dataset.key] =
checkbox.checked;


});


localStorage.setItem(
this.storageKey,
JSON.stringify(state)
);



// Notify Dashboard

window.dispatchEvent(

new CustomEvent(
'checklistUpdated'
)

);


}







/* TABS */


setupTabs(){


this.tabs.forEach(
tab=>{


tab.addEventListener(
'click',
()=>{


const target =
tab.dataset.tab;



this.tabs.forEach(
item=>{

item.setAttribute(
'aria-selected',
'false'
);

});



this.panels.forEach(
panel=>{

panel.classList.remove(
'active'
);

});



tab.setAttribute(
'aria-selected',
'true'
);



const panel =
this.querySelector(
`[data-panel="${target}"]`
);



if(panel){

panel.classList.add(
'active'
);

}



this.updateProgress();



});

});



}









/* CHECKBOX EVENTS */


setupCheckboxes(){


this.checkboxes.forEach(
checkbox=>{


checkbox.addEventListener(
'change',
()=>{


const item =
checkbox.closest(
'.ai-check-item-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn'
);



if(
checkbox.checked
){


item.classList.add(
'done'
);


item.animate(

[
{
transform:'scale(1)'
},

{
transform:'scale(1.02)'
},

{
transform:'scale(1)'
}

],

{
duration:250
}

);


}

else{


item.classList.remove(
'done'
);


}



this.saveState();


this.updateAll();



});

});



}








/* UPDATE EVERYTHING */


updateAll(){


this.updateProgress();


this.updateTabCounts();



}









/* GLOBAL PROGRESS */


updateProgress(){



const total =
this.checkboxes.length;



const completed =
Array.from(
this.checkboxes
)
.filter(
checkbox=>checkbox.checked
)
.length;



const percentage =
total
?
Math.round(
(completed / total) * 100
)
:
0;




if(this.progressFill){

this.progressFill.style.width =
percentage + '%';

}



if(this.progressLabel){

this.progressLabel.textContent =
`${completed} of ${total} complete`;

}



if(this.progressScore){

this.progressScore.textContent =
percentage + '%';

}



}









/* TAB COUNTERS */


updateTabCounts(){


const panels =
Array.from(this.panels).filter(
panel => panel.dataset.panel
);



panels.forEach(
(panel,index)=>{


const items =
panel.querySelectorAll(
'input[type="checkbox"]'
);



const completed =
Array.from(items)
.filter(
item=>item.checked
)
.length;



if(
this.tabCounts[index]
){


this.tabCounts[index]
.textContent =
`${completed}/${items.length}`;


}



});


}



}



customElements.define(

'ai-checklist-aemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn',

AiChecklistaemlvsgzommjazg1mvaigenblock5989a1ebpbkgn

);



})();
</script>

        <div class="ai-faq-label-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Frequently Asked Questions</div>
      
      
        <h2 class="ai-faq-title-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Common questions about Cyclosporiasis and sanitation</h2>
      
      
    </div>

    <div class="ai-faq-list-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              What is Cyclosporiasis?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Cyclosporiasis is an intestinal illness caused by the microscopic parasite Cyclospora cayetanensis. It affects the small intestine and typically causes watery diarrhea, according to the CDC.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              How does Cyclospora spread?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">People become infected by consuming food or water contaminated with feces containing the parasite. It's not typically spread directly person-to-person, since shed oocysts need one to two weeks in the environment before they can infect someone else.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              What foods are commonly associated with Cyclospora?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Past U.S. outbreaks have most often been linked to fresh produce — leafy greens, herbs, and pre-cut salad or vegetable mixes are common examples in CDC outbreak history. Each outbreak is traced individually rather than assumed from a prior one.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              Who is at higher risk?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Anyone can become infected. People who are immunocompromised may experience more prolonged or severe illness. Reported cases span a wide age range.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              What are the symptoms?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">The most common symptom is watery diarrhea, sometimes frequent or explosive. Loss of appetite, weight loss, bloating, gas, cramping, nausea, and fatigue are also reported; low-grade fever and vomiting are less common.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              When should I see a doctor?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Contact a healthcare provider if you have watery diarrhea lasting more than a few days, or any signs of dehydration. Cyclospora testing requires specific lab methods a clinician has to request by name.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              Can surfaces transmit Cyclospora?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Cyclospora is primarily food- and water-borne, not a typical surface-contact pathogen. The CDC notes it's unlikely to be killed by routine chemical disinfection or sanitizing methods — prevention centers on food and water safety, not surface disinfection.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              Should restaurants review cleaning procedures during food safety events?
              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Many operators use periods of heightened food safety attention to review sourcing, produce handling, employee hygiene, and sanitation schedules — as part of a broader program, not as a response specific to Cyclospora alone.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">

              <span class="ai-faq-arrow-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">⌄</span>

            <div class="ai-faq-answer-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">
              <div class="ai-faq-answer-content-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp">Wipes formulated and labeled to disinfect specific hard, non-porous surfaces against the pathogens listed on their EPA-approved label, when used according to that label's instructions and contact time.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        
      
        
        
        
        

        
          <div class="ai-faq-item-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" data-faq-item>
            <button class="ai-faq-question-acjrrn1jcdlbwevjtraigenblock4c65df0rhwepp" aria-expanded="false">
              What are alcohol wipes used for?

  <script>
function getVariantFromURL() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const variant = urlParams.get('variant');
    console.log("Extracted Variant ID:", variant);
    return variant;
}

function getProductIdFromLoopWidget() {
    if (typeof LOOP_WIDGET === 'undefined') {
        console.log("LOOP_WIDGET is not defined.");
        return null;
    }

    const productIds = Object.keys(LOOP_WIDGET);
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        console.log("No product ID found in LOOP_WIDGET.");
        return null;
    }

    const pid = productIds[0];
    console.log("Extracted Product ID from LOOP_WIDGET:", pid);
    return pid;
}

function handleVariantChange() {
    const variantId = getVariantFromURL();
    if (!variantId) {
        console.log("No variant ID found in URL.");
        return;
    }

    const pid = getProductIdFromLoopWidget();
    if (!pid) {
        console.log("Failed to get product ID.");
        return;
    }

    const inputElement = document.querySelector('input[name="product-id"]');
    if (inputElement && window?.LoopSubscriptions) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            console.log(
                "Updating LoopSubscriptions with product ID:",
                inputElement.value,
                "and variant ID:",
                variantId
            );
            window.LoopSubscriptions.handleLoopWidgetVariantIdChange(
                Number(inputElement.value),
                Number(variantId)
            );
        }, 0);
    } else {
        console.warn("LoopSubscriptions or product-id input not available.");
    }
}

// Run on page load
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", handleVariantChange);

// Listen for SPA URL changes (history API manipulation)
(function () {
    let lastUrl = location.href;

    new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (location.href !== lastUrl) {
            lastUrl = location.href;
            console.log("URL changed, re-running variant check.");
            handleVariantChange();
        }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, childList: true });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleVariantChange);
})();
</script>

      // Function to fetch the cart information via AJAX
    function updateCart() {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/cart.js',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function(cartData) {
               var cartTotal = cartData.total_price;
                var itemCount = cartData.item_count;
               $('.cart-link__bubble').text(itemCount);
              const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
              const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
              
              if(cartTotal > 0){
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'block';
                
                updateProgressBar(cartTotal,itemCount);
              }else{
                shipMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
                shipMessageElement2.style.display = 'none';
               
              }
               
            },
            error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                console.error('Error updating cart:', errorThrown);
            }
        });
    }

    updateCart();
    setInterval(updateCart, 500);
  
    function updateProgressBar(cartTotal, itemCount) {
      const progressWrapper = document.getElementById('cart-progress-wrapper');
    
      const progressThreshold = parseInt(progressWrapper.dataset.threshold, 10);
      const preGoalMessageTemplate = progressWrapper.dataset.preGoalMessageTemplate;
      const postGoalMessage = progressWrapper.dataset.postGoalMessage;
    
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('cart-progress-bar');
      const percntcstmId = document.getElementById('percntcstmId');
      
      const goalMessageElement = document.querySelector('.goal-message');
      
      const shipMessageElement = document.querySelector('.cstm-announcement-bar-cls');
      const shipMessageElement2 = document.querySelector('.announcement-bar-shipping');
      
      
      if (itemCount === 0 || cartTotal === 0) {
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'none';
        }
       
      } else {
       
        if (progressWrapper) {
          progressWrapper.style.display = 'block'; 
        }
        if (progressBar) {
          progressBar.style.display = 'block';
          const progressPercentage = Math.min((cartTotal / progressThreshold) * 100, 100); 
          progressBar.style.width = `${progressPercentage}%`;
            percntcstmId.textContent =`${progressPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`;
    
          if (progressPercentage >= 100) {
            progressWrapper.classList.add('full');
          } else {
            progressWrapper.classList.remove('full');
          }
        }
      
        if (goalMessageElement) {
          goalMessageElement.style.display = 'block';
          let remainingForGoal = progressThreshold - cartTotal;
      
          if (remainingForGoal < 0) {
            remainingForGoal = 0;
          }
      
          const remainingAmountFormatted = `$${(remainingForGoal / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
          const preGoalMessage = preGoalMessageTemplate.replace('[remainingForGoalFormatted]', remainingAmountFormatted);
          goalMessageElement.innerHTML = remainingForGoal > 0
            ? preGoalMessage
            : postGoalMessage;
        }
      }
    }

<script>
(function() {
  class ChecklistTrackeray3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge extends HTMLElement {
    constructor() {
      super();

      this.storageKey = this.dataset.storageKey;

      this.progressFill = this.querySelector('[data-progress-fill]');
      this.progressText = this.querySelector('[data-progress-text]');
      this.progressPercent = this.querySelector('[data-progress-percent]');

      this.stickyScore = this.querySelector('[data-sticky-score]');
      this.ringProgress = this.querySelector('[data-ring-progress]');
      this.ringPercent = this.querySelector('[data-ring-percent]');
      this.stickyCompleted = this.querySelector('[data-sticky-completed]');

      this.checkboxes = this.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');
      this.categories = this.querySelectorAll('[data-category]');
    }

    connectedCallback() {
      this.loadState();
      this.setupEventListeners();

      // abrir primeira categoria
      const firstCategory = this.querySelector('[data-category]');
      if (firstCategory) {
        firstCategory.classList.add('open');

        const button = firstCategory.querySelector('.ai-cat-head-ay3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge');
        if (button) button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }

      this.updateProgress();
      this.handleStickyBar();
    }

    setupEventListeners() {
      // CHECKBOX EVENTS
      this.checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
        checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => {
          this.saveState();
          this.updateProgress();
        });
      });

      // CATEGORY TOGGLE
      this.categories.forEach((category) => {
        const button = category.querySelector('.ai-cat-head-ay3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge');
        if (!button) return;

        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const isOpen = category.classList.contains('open');
          category.classList.toggle('open');
          button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isOpen));
        });
      });

      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => this.handleStickyBar());
    }

    loadState() {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
        if (!saved) return;

        const state = JSON.parse(saved);

        this.checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
          const itemId = checkbox.dataset.item;
          if (state[itemId]) checkbox.checked = true;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to load checklist state:', e);
      }
    }

    saveState() {
      try {
        const state = {};

        this.checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
          const itemId = checkbox.dataset.item;
          state[itemId] = checkbox.checked;
        });

        localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(state));
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to save checklist state:', e);
      }
    }

    updateProgress() {
      const total = this.checkboxes.length;
      const completed = Array.from(this.checkboxes).filter(cb => cb.checked).length;

      const percent = total ? Math.round((completed / total) * 100) : 0;

      let level = 'High Risk';
      if (percent >= 25) level = 'Moderate';
      if (percent >= 50) level = 'Ready';
      if (percent >= 80) level = 'Excellent';

      const readinessLevel = this.querySelector('[data-readiness-level]');
      if (readinessLevel) {
        readinessLevel.textContent = level;
      }

      if (this.progressFill) {
        this.progressFill.style.width = percent + '%';
      }

      if (this.progressText) {
        this.progressText.textContent = `${completed} of ${total} completed`;
      }

      if (this.progressPercent) {
        this.progressPercent.textContent = percent + '%';
      }

      if (this.ringPercent) {
        this.ringPercent.textContent = percent + '%';
      }

      if (this.stickyCompleted) {
        this.stickyCompleted.textContent = `${completed} of ${total} completed`;
      }

      if (this.ringProgress) {
        const circumference = 125.6;
        const offset = circumference - (percent / 100) * circumference;
        this.ringProgress.style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
      }

      // CATEGORY SCORES + DASHBOARD

this.categories.forEach((category) => {

  const categoryId = category.dataset.category;

  const checkboxes =
    category.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');

  const totalItems = checkboxes.length;

  const checkedItems =
    Array.from(checkboxes).filter(cb => cb.checked).length;

  const scoreElement =
    category.querySelector(
      `[data-category-score="${categoryId}"]`
    );

  if(scoreElement){
    scoreElement.textContent =
      `${checkedItems} of ${totalItems} checked`;
  }

  // DASHBOARD COUNT

  const dashCount =
    this.querySelector(
      `[data-dashboard-cat-count="${categoryId}"]`
    );

  if(dashCount){
    dashCount.textContent =
      `${checkedItems}/${totalItems}`;
  }

  // DASHBOARD BAR

  const dashBar =
    this.querySelector(
      `[data-dashboard-cat-bar="${categoryId}"]`
    );

  if(dashBar){

    const catPercent =
      totalItems
        ? Math.round(
            (checkedItems / totalItems) * 100
          )
        : 0;

    dashBar.style.width =
      catPercent + '%';
  }
});

// BIG SCORE

const dashboardScore =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-dashboard-score]'
  );

if(dashboardScore){
  dashboardScore.textContent =
    percent + '%';
}

// LEVEL

const dashboardLevel =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-dashboard-level]'
  );

const dashboardDescription =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-dashboard-description]'
  );

if(dashboardLevel){

  dashboardLevel.textContent = level;

  if(level === 'High Risk'){

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'Your operation may struggle during major hospitality events.';

  } else if(level === 'Moderate'){

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'You are making progress but there are still gaps to address.';

  } else if(level === 'Ready'){

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'Your restaurant is well prepared for seasonal demand.';

  } else {

    dashboardDescription.textContent =
      'Excellent. Your operation is fully prepared.';
  }
}

// CELEBRATION

const celebration =
  this.querySelector(
    '[data-celebration]'
  );

  // ==============================
// SUGGESTED NEXT STEPS
// ==============================

const suggestions = this.querySelector('[data-dashboard-suggestions]');
const allCompleteText = "All items complete. Great work.";
const defaultEmptyText = "Start checking items to receive suggestions.";

if (suggestions) {

  suggestions.innerHTML = '';

  // ===================================
  // EMPTY STATE (nenhum item marcado)
  // ===================================

  if (completed === 0) {

    suggestions.innerHTML = `
      <p class="ai-dashboard-empty-ay3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge">
        ${defaultEmptyText}
      </p>
    `;

  }

  // ===================================
  // 100%
  // ===================================

  else if (percent === 100) {

    suggestions.innerHTML = `
      <p class="ai-dashboard-empty-ay3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge">
        ${allCompleteText}
      </p>
    `;

  }

  // ===================================
  // SUGGESTIONS
  // ===================================

  else {

    this.categories.forEach(category => {

      const categoryTitle =
        category.querySelector('h3')?.textContent || '';

      const items =
        category.querySelectorAll('.ai-check-item-ay3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge');

      for (const item of items) {

        const checkbox =
          item.querySelector('input');

        if (!checkbox.checked) {

          const text =
            item.querySelector('span').textContent;

          suggestions.insertAdjacentHTML(
            'beforeend',
            `
            <div class="sugg-item">
              <span class="arrow">→</span>

              <div>
                <strong>${categoryTitle}</strong>
                <span>${text}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            `
          );

          // Apenas uma sugestão por categoria
          break;
        }

      }

    });

  }

}

if(celebration){

  if(percent >= 80){

    celebration.classList.add('show');

  }else{

    celebration.classList.remove('show');
  }
}

// ==========================
// DASHBOARD 2
// ==========================


const dash2Percent =
this.querySelector('[data-dashboard2-percent]');


const dash2Fill =
this.querySelector('[data-dashboard2-fill]');


const dash2Grade =
this.querySelector('[data-dashboard2-grade]');



if(dash2Percent){

dash2Percent.textContent =
percent + '%';

}



if(dash2Fill){

dash2Fill.style.width =
percent + '%';

}



if(dash2Grade){


let grade='F';


if(percent >= 95){

grade='A+';

}
else if(percent >=80){

grade='A';

}
else if(percent >=60){

grade='B';

}
else if(percent >=40){

grade='C';

}
else if(percent >=20){

grade='D';

}



dash2Grade.textContent =
grade;



if(percent >=80){

dash2Grade.classList.add('good');

}else{

dash2Grade.classList.remove('good');

}


}

// GLOBAL EVENT

window.dispatchEvent(
  new CustomEvent('checklistUpdated',{
    detail:{
      percent,
      completed,
      total,
      level
    }
  })
);
}

    handleStickyBar() {
      if (!this.stickyScore) return;

      const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
      const isScrolledPast = rect.bottom < window.innerHeight;

      if (isScrolledPast) {
        this.stickyScore.classList.add('show');
      } else {
        this.stickyScore.classList.remove('show');
      }
    }
  }

  customElements.define(
    'checklist-tracker-ay3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge',
    ChecklistTrackeray3ziqwxteuzrm1bvaaigenblocke6e2ccdrxdkge
  );
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {

  class QuizComponentas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam extends HTMLElement {

    constructor() {

      super();

      this.currentStep = 0;
      this.totalSteps = 5;
      this.answers = {};

    }


    connectedCallback() {

      this.steps = this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-step-as2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');

      this.progressBar = this.querySelector('#quizProgressas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');

      this.progressText = this.querySelector('#quizProgressTextas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');

      this.backBtn = this.querySelector('#quizBackas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');

      this.nextBtn = this.querySelector('#quizNextas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');

      this.restartBtn = this.querySelector('#quizRestartas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');

      this.form = this.querySelector('#quizFormas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');

      this.resultDiv = this.querySelector('#quizResultas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');


      this.initProgressBar();

      this.attachEventListeners();

      this.updateButtons();

    }



    initProgressBar() {

      if(!this.progressBar) return;


      for(let i = 0; i < this.totalSteps; i++){

        const bar = document.createElement('div');

        this.progressBar.appendChild(bar);

      }


      this.updateProgressBar();

    }



    attachEventListeners(){


      if(this.backBtn){

        this.backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.goBack();

        });

      }



      if(this.nextBtn){

        this.nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.goNext();

        });

      }



      if(this.restartBtn){

        this.restartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          this.restartQuiz();

        });

      }



      this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-as2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam')
      .forEach(option => {


        option.addEventListener('click', (e) => {


          e.preventDefault();


          const input = option.querySelector('input');


          const step = option.closest('.ai-quiz-step-as2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');



          step.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-as2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam')
          .forEach(opt => {

            opt.classList.remove('selected');

          });



          option.classList.add('selected');


          if(input){

            input.checked = true;

          }



          this.nextBtn.disabled = false;



        });


      });


    }




    updateProgressBar(){


      const bars = this.progressBar.querySelectorAll('div');


      bars.forEach((bar,index)=>{


        if(index < this.currentStep){

          bar.classList.add('done');

        } else {

          bar.classList.remove('done');

        }


      });



      if(this.progressText){

        this.progressText.textContent =
        `Question ${this.currentStep + 1} of ${this.totalSteps}`;

      }


    }




    goBack(){


      if(this.currentStep > 0){


        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.remove('active');


        this.currentStep--;


        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.add('active');


        this.updateProgressBar();

        this.updateButtons();


      }


    }





    goNext(){


      const currentQuestion =
      this.steps[this.currentStep]
      .querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');



      if(!currentQuestion){

        return;

      }



      this.answers['q' + (this.currentStep + 1)] =
      parseInt(currentQuestion.value);



      if(this.currentStep < this.totalSteps - 1){



        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.remove('active');



        this.currentStep++;



        this.steps[this.currentStep]
        .classList.add('active');



        this.updateProgressBar();


        this.updateButtons();



      } else {


        this.showResults();


      }


    }





    updateButtons(){


      if(this.backBtn){

        this.backBtn.disabled =
        this.currentStep === 0;

      }



      const currentAnswer =
      this.steps[this.currentStep]
      .querySelector('input[type="radio"]:checked');



      if(this.nextBtn){

        this.nextBtn.disabled =
        !currentAnswer;


        if(this.currentStep === this.totalSteps - 1){

          this.nextBtn.textContent =
          'See results';

        } else {

          this.nextBtn.textContent =
          'Next';

        }

      }


    }







    showResults(){


      const total =
      Object.values(this.answers)
      .reduce((sum,val)=>sum + val,0);



      let resultTitle = '';

      let resultText = '';

      let resultImage = '';

      let resultLink = '';




      if(total <= 7){


        resultTitle =
        'Starter Kit';


        resultText =
        'Perfect for small spaces and individual classrooms.';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/70_IPA_Alcohol_Wipes_Single_Sachet_100ct_Dispenser_Box--isopropyl-alcohol-70-ipa-wipes-single-sachet-100ct-dispenser-box.webp?v=1767024869';


        resultLink =
        '/products/isopropyl-alcohol-70-ipa-wipes-single-sachet-100ct-dispenser-box';


      }

      else if(total <= 11){


        resultTitle =
        'School Bundle';


        resultText =
        'Ideal for single buildings with regular cleaning needs.';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Wipex_70_Pure_Isopropyl_Alcohol_Wipes_Canister_80ct_Commercial_Industrial_Grade--wipex-70-alcohol-multi-surface-cleaning-wipes-75ct-canister.webp?v=1767027386';


        resultLink =
        '/products/wipex-70-alcohol-multi-surface-cleaning-wipes-75ct-canister';


      }

      else {


        resultTitle =
        'District Solution';


        resultText =
        'Comprehensive solution for multi-building campuses and high-traffic facilities.';


        resultImage =
        '//wipex.co/cdn/shop/files/Wipex_Bulk_Isopropyl_Alcohol_Wipes_70_96_1000ct_Bucket--isopropyl-alcohol-wipes-bulk-1000-count.webp?v=1767025499';


        resultLink =
        '/products/isopropyl-alcohol-wipes-bulk-1000-count';


      }




      const image =
      this.querySelector('#resultImageas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');


      const title =
      this.querySelector('#resultTitleas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');


      const text =
      this.querySelector('#resultTextas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');


      const link =
      this.querySelector('#resultLinkas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam');




      if(image && resultImage){

        image.src = resultImage;

      }


      if(title){

        title.textContent = resultTitle;

      }


      if(text){

        text.textContent = resultText;

      }


      if(link){

        link.href = resultLink;

      }




      this.form.style.display = 'none';


      this.resultDiv.classList.add('active');


    }







    restartQuiz(){


      this.currentStep = 0;

      this.answers = {};



      this.resultDiv.classList.remove('active');


      this.form.style.display = 'block';



      this.steps.forEach((step,index)=>{


        step.classList.toggle(
          'active',
          index === 0
        );


      });




      this.querySelectorAll('.ai-quiz-option-as2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam')
      .forEach(option=>{


        option.classList.remove('selected');


        const input =
        option.querySelector('input');


        if(input){

          input.checked = false;

        }


      });



      this.updateProgressBar();


      this.updateButtons();


    }



  }




  customElements.define(
    'quiz-component-as2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam',
    QuizComponentas2fwoglxwnr6zmyxbaigenblockf7b6d97ufbeam
  );


})();
</script>

<script>
  (function() {
