        this.studentsInput = this.querySelector('[data-students-input]');
        this.frequencyInput = this.querySelector('[data-frequency-input]');
        this.classroomsVal = this.querySelector('[data-classrooms-val]');
        this.studentsVal = this.querySelector('[data-students-val]');
        this.calcNumber = this.querySelector('[data-calc-number]');
        this.recName = this.querySelector('[data-rec-name]');
        this.recLink = this.querySelector('[data-rec-link]');
        this.progressBar = this.querySelector('[data-progress]');
this.classroomsChip = this.querySelector('[data-classrooms-chip]');
this.studentsChip = this.querySelector('[data-students-chip]');

this.currentNumber = 0;

        this.products = [
          {
            name: 'Small Pack (100ct Dispenser Box)',
            url: '/products/isopropyl-alcohol-70-ipa-wipes-single-sachet-100ct-dispenser-box',
            threshold: 100
          },
          {
            name: 'Canister Pack (80ct)',
            url: '/products/wipex-70-alcohol-multi-surface-cleaning-wipes-75ct-canister',
            threshold: 80
          },
          {
            name: 'Large Pack (1000ct Bucket)',
            url: '/products/isopropyl-alcohol-wipes-bulk-1000-count',
            threshold: 1000
          }
        ].filter(p => p.name && p.url);
      }

      connectedCallback() {
        this.classroomsInput.addEventListener('input', () => this.updateCalculation());
        this.studentsInput.addEventListener('input', () => this.updateCalculation());
        this.frequencyInput.addEventListener('change', () => this.updateCalculation());
        this.updateCalculation();
      }

      updateCalculation() {

  const classrooms = parseInt(this.classroomsInput.value);
  const students = parseInt(this.studentsInput.value);
  const frequency = parseInt(this.frequencyInput.value);

  this.classroomsVal.textContent = classrooms;
  this.studentsVal.textContent = students;

  if(this.classroomsChip){

    this.classroomsChip.textContent =
    classrooms + ' ' + this.dataset.classroomsSuffix;

}

if(this.studentsChip){

    this.studentsChip.textContent =
    students + ' ' + this.dataset.studentsSuffix;

}

  /*----------------------------------
      Monthly estimation
  ----------------------------------*/

  const schoolDays = 20;

  const wipesPerStudent =
      2;

  const wipesPerClassroom =
      50;

  const wipesPerMonth = Math.round(

    (
        classrooms * 24 +
        students * 9
    )

    * (frequency * 0.45)

);

  this.calcNumber.textContent =
      wipesPerMonth.toLocaleString();

  this.updateRecommendation(wipesPerMonth);

}

animateNumber(target){

    const duration = 600;

    const start = this.currentNumber;

    const startTime = performance.now();

    const animate = (time)=>{

        const progress = Math.min(
            (time-startTime)/duration,
            1
        );

        const value = Math.floor(

            start +

            (target-start)

            *

            this.easeOut(progress)

        );

        this.calcNumber.textContent =
            value.toLocaleString();

        if(progress<1){

            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

        }else{

            this.currentNumber = target;

        }

    };

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);

}

easeOut(x){

    return 1-Math.pow(1-x,3);

}

updateProgress(wipes){

    if(!this.progressBar) return;

    const max = 1000;

    const percent = Math.min(

        wipes/max*100,

        100

    );

    this.progressBar.style.width = percent+"%";

}

    let recommendation = {};

    if (wipes <= 800){

        recommendation = {
            name: `${Math.ceil(wipes/100)} × 100ct Alcohol Wipes Dispenser Box`,
            url: '/products/isopropyl-alcohol-70-ipa-wipes-single-sachet-100ct-dispenser-box'
        };

    } else if (wipes <= 3000){

        recommendation = {
            name: `${Math.ceil(wipes/80)} × 80ct Alcohol Wipes Canister`,
            url: '/products/wipex-70-alcohol-multi-surface-cleaning-wipes-75ct-canister'
        };

    } else {

        const buckets = Math.ceil(wipes / 1000);

        recommendation = {
            name: `${buckets} × 1000ct Alcohol Wipes Bucket`,
            url: '/products/isopropyl-alcohol-wipes-bulk-1000-count'
        };

    }

    this.recName.style.opacity = 0;
